  • Manage your privacy and data security
  • Todoist Assist supports your productivity
  • Get in touch

Use the Task Assist extension with Todoist

The Task Assist extension consists of several nifty options that can enhance your workflows. Can’t think of a good task name? Need some help creating sub-tasks to break down that task? Task Assist can help!

Set up the extension

Warning

The Task Assist extension isn’t available on Todoist for iOS or Android. Make sure to use Todoist on your web browser or the desktop apps.

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com or the desktop apps.
  • Click your avatar in the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click Integrations in the side menu.
  • Click Browse at the top of the Integrations settings.
  • In the list of available integrations, select Task Assist.
  • Click Add.
  • Click Confirm. When running the extension for the first time, you’re asked to grant access to read and write application data.

Suggest tasks

If you have a bigger achievement in mind, but don’t know where to start, get some suggestions! This option will generate a list of task suggestions to help you reach your goal. Here’s how:

  • In any Todoist project, click the three dots icon in the top-right corner to open the project menu.
  • Click Suggest tasks with Task Assist.
  • In the modal that opens, use the text field to enter a task that you want to break up into smaller chunks and click Suggest tasks.
  • Review the suggested list of tasks.
  • Click Add.

Get tips for completing a task

If you’re struggling to figure out how to progress on a certain task, why not ask for a tip?

Use this option on one of your existing tasks. It will generate the next actionable step to complete it:

  • Click any existing task to open the task view.
  • Click the three dots icon in the top-right of the task view. If you’re viewing the tasks in a list, hover over the task and click the three dots icon on the right.
  • Select Task Assist.
  • Click Give tips for completing task. Task Assist will generate the next actionable step for this task.
  • Click Add as comment to add the tip to your task’s comment.
  • If you’d like to generate a new tip, click Try again.
  • To close Task Assist and cancel the action, click Cancel.

Make tasks more actionable

If you’d like to rewrite your tasks to make it easier to start working on them, this option will help you achieve this:

  • Click any existing task to open the task view.
  • Click the three dots icon in the top-right of the task view. If you’re viewing the tasks in a list, hover over the task and click the three dots icon on the right.
  • Select Task Assist.
  • Click Make task more actionable. Task Assist will generate an alternative name for this task.
  • If you’d like to use the new name generated by the extension, click Rewrite task.
  • Click Try again if you’d like to see a different variant of the task.
  • To close Task Assist and cancel the action, click Cancel.

Break a task down into sub-tasks

When you have a complex task that requires multiple steps, use this option to break it down and generate a list of sub-tasks. Here’s how:

  • Click any existing task to open the task view.
  • Click the three dots icon in the top-right corner of the task view. If you’re viewing the tasks in a list, you can hover over the task and click the three dots icon on the right.
  • Select Task Assist.
  • Click Break task down.
  • Task Assist will generate a list of sub-tasks. Review the list and deselect the boxes for sub-tasks that are not required.
  • Click Add sub-tasks to add them to your existing task.
  • If you’d like to generate a new list of sub-tasks, click Try again.
  • To close Task Assist and cancel the action, click Cancel.

Remove the extension

  • Click your avatar in the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click Integrations in the side menu.
  • Click Task Assist.
  • Select Remove.
  • Click Remove to confirm.

FAQ

Generally, the rule of thumb is that the more specific and qualified the data, the better the output. For example, instead of using the query “How do I lose weight?” you could say “I’m a male that weighs 220 lbs and I’m 6’2” tall. I would like to lose 20 lbs. What’s the easiest way to do that?”

The AI-based extension works best in English. Whilst it also supports input in other languages, you may notice it won’t work equally well in all of them. Whilst we ourselves have no control over this, this will likely improve in the future through OpenAI’s development of better models.

The extension isn’t enabled in your Todoist account by default, so if you haven’t installed it, there’s no further action required.

If you already have the extension installed but want to disable it, you can remove it by following the instructions above.

With this integration, Todoist does not give OpenAI access to any of your Todoist data. However, OpenAI may use user input (queries) to improve their models.

One of the limitations of our Task Assist extension is that it may output harmful content when prompted. At Todoist, we’re committed to working towards developing a system that won’t cause any harm. As part of this responsibility, we’ve implemented a warning message that alerts you about potential harmful output when our system recognizes a harmful query.

Add an Add Task quick setting tile on Android

The “Add task” Quick Setting tile for Android is a handy way to quickly add tasks to Todoist.

Note

Some of these steps work only on Android 13 and up. Learn how to check your Android version.

To add, remove or move the “Add task” Quick Setting tile follow these simple steps:

  • From the top of your screen, swipe down twice.
  • At the bottom-left, tap the pencil icon.
  • Touch and hold the setting.
  • Drag the setting to where you want it.
    • To add Add task, drag it up from “Hold and drag to add tiles.”
    • To remove Add task, drag it down to “Drag here to remove.” Quick tip

Your first several settings tiles become your Quick Settings bar.

Add Todoist shortcuts to your Android home screen

Note

Todoist home screen shortcuts are only available on Android 7.1 and higher.

Todoist for Android has the following shortcuts for content inside the app:

  • Add task

  • Filter

  • Label

  • Project

  • Search

  • Today

  • Upcoming To add Todoist shortcuts to your Home screen follow these steps:

  • Tap and hold the app icon. You’ll see a list of shortcuts.

  • Tap and hold the shortcut.

  • Drag the shortcut to where you want it, then lift your finger. Note

Please note, that only Add task, Search, and Today views will appear in the list of available shortcuts by default. If you’d like to add a shortcut for the Upcoming, Project, Filter, or Label views to your home screen, open this view in your Todoist app, before following the instructions above.

Use a Todoist widget on your Android device

Todoist widgets give you easy access to your task list from your Android home screen, saving you time and keeping you on top of everything.

There are four types of widgets you can place anywhere on your home screen:

  • Add task shortcut: Open Quick Add to add a task.
  • Task list widget: Control Todoist right from your home screen (see below).
  • Productivity widget: Get an overview of your current productivity stats, like your current Karma score and how close you are to reaching your daily goals. If you’re a Todoist Pro or Business customer, you’ll also have the option to display your weekly goals and trends.
  • Ramble widget: Open Ramble directly in listening mode to capture tasks hands-free, without opening the full Todoist app. Note

If your Karma score isn’t visible in the Productivity widget, check if Karma is turned on for your account. If you don’t have an internet connection and you’ve cleared the app cache, the Karma won’t be able to load.

Add a Todoist widget

  • Press and hold an empty area on the home screen.
  • Select Widgets.
  • Find and tap Todoist. You’ll see a list of available widgets.
  • Press and hold your preferred widget.
  • Tap Add to add it to your home screen. Note

These steps may differ depending on your Android device’s settings. If you’re not sure where the setting is located or if the interface is different, contact your device manufacturer.

Set up the Todoist task list widget

If you choose the Todoist task list widget, the Widget settings screen will open to help you customize your widget. As you select your options, you’ll see a preview of your widget at the top of the screen.

  • Choose view: Choose which view, project, label, or filter you’ll see in the widget. You can change this later.
  • Theme: Select a custom theme for the widget itself. From the classic Todoist red and white to dark theme, it’s up to you. This choice will only affect your widget theme.
  • Font size: Choose between the Normal size (as it appears in the app) or the Small size to see more tasks.
  • Opacity: Set how transparent your widget will be. 0 is fully transparent, 100 is opaque.
  • Compact mode: Select compact mode and your widget will display more tasks at once by reducing the size of each task. You’ll still see dates and priorities (as a color to the left of a task), but you won’t see a complete task circle. Simply tap a task to open task view to see every detail and complete the task.
  • Show Todoist icon: Select to show the Todoist icon in your widget’s toolbar. When you tap the app icon, it will take you straight to Todoist.
  • Use preset style: Choose from a handful of recommended preset styles like Transparent dark or Compact. Tap the checkmark icon at the top-right to save your changes.

Use the Todoist task list widget

Once the Todoist task list widget is active, here are a few ways to use it:

  • Tap a task to open the task view and make changes to it.
  • Tap the circle icon next to the task to complete it. However, this isn’t available in Compact mode.
  • Tap the down arrow icon at the top-left of the widget to switch to another project, label, or filter.
  • Tap the plus icon at the top-right to create a task.
  • Tap the Todoist icon at the top-left to open the Todoist app.
  • Press and hold the widget. Then, drag the handles at the edges to resize the widget to your preferred size.

Set up the Todoist productivity widget

If you choose the Todoist productivity widget, the Widget settings screen will open to help you customize your widget. As you select your options, you’ll see a preview of your widget at the top of the screen:

  • Theme: Select a custom color theme for your widget. You can easily change it depending on your mood or to better fit your screen background. The selected theme will be applied only to the widget itself.
  • Opacity: Set how transparent your widget will be: 0 is fully transparent, 100 is opaque.
  • Widget tap: Select whether you’d like to open the Productivity view or Home page on tap.
  • Productivity settings: Whether you’ve decided to be more ambitious or to slow down, edit your productivity goals whenever you need.
  • Widget size: To resize the widget, press and hold it. Then, drag the handles at the left and right edges to make the widget more wide or narrow. Tap the checkmark icon at the top-right to save your changes.

Use the Ramble widget

The Ramble widget is a 1×1 shortcut that opens Ramble in listening mode as soon as you tap it, so you can capture tasks hands-free without opening the full Todoist app.

Note

You’ll only see the Ramble widget in the widget picker after you’ve launched and completed at least one Ramble session in the Todoist app.

To place the Ramble widget on your home screen:

  • Press and hold the Todoist app icon on your home screen.
  • Select Widgets.
  • Press and hold the Ramble widget.
  • Drag it to your preferred spot on the home screen. Once the widget is in place, tap it any time to start a Ramble in listening mode and speak your tasks.

Change the Todoist widget settings

If you need to make changes to the widget later, press and hold the widget. Then, drag it to Widget settings at the top-right of your home screen. This opens the widget settings.

If your device is running on Android 11 or earlier, tap the gear icon inside the widget to view or change its settings.

This may differ depending on your Android device’s settings. If you’re not sure where the setting is located or if the interface is different, contact your device manufacturer.

Troubleshoot the Todoist widget

If the Todoist widget becomes frozen, it may be affected by an automatic battery saver in some Android devices. To fix this:

  • Open your device Settings.
  • Open Apps.
  • Scroll down and find Todoist.
  • Tap Battery and select Optimized battery usage.
  • Tap back to save the change.

Use Todoist on Wear OS

Todoist for Wear OS gives you full control of Todoist right from your watch.

Play

You can add new tasks, check and complete your tasks, set custom complications and more.

Install Todoist for Wear OS

  • Open Google Play on your Wear OS device.
  • Search for Todoist.
  • Tap Install.
  • Sign in with your phone account, Google account, or Todoist email and password. Note

Unlike the previous version of Todoist for Android Wear, you won’t have to sync Todoist for Wear OS with your phone. It’s a fully standalone app.

Check in on your tasks and navigating

You can browse through views like Inbox as well as look at any favorite project, label, or filter in Todoist Wear OS. Here’s how:

  • Open the Todoist app on your watch.
  • You’ll see the menu by default. Scroll down to find the view you’re looking for, e.g. Inbox, Today, Upcoming, or your favorite project, label or filter, and tap on it to view the list of tasks.
  • Once done, swipe right to get back to the previous screen to choose another view.

Add a task

Have a new task to add? Just tell your wrist about it. Here’s how:

  • Open the Todoist app on your watch.
  • Tap Add task at the top of the screen.
  • (Optional) You can also tap Add Task at the bottom of any tasks list. In order to add sub-tasks, open the task view and tap Add sub-task.
  • Select the task input method (not available on all watches).
  • Speak or type your task name. Your watch will recognize dates, too, so you can say things like today, next Saturday or May 31.
  • You’ll see the screen with parsed results of your input, where you can change task name, date, project, and add a description.
  • Scroll down and tap Add task to add the new task.

Schedule or reschedule a task

If you need to add a due date or change the existing due date, here’s how:

  • Open the Todoist app on your watch.
  • Open the view containing the task you want to reschedule.
  • Tap on the task you’d like to reschedule.
  • Scroll down and tap the due date.
  • You can speak or type (not available on all watches) the new date, or tap the shortcuts like Tomorrow, Next week and Postpone.

Complete a task

Complete a task on your watch with a tap:

  • Open the Todoist app on your watch.
  • Open the view containing the task you want to complete.
  • Tap on the circle to the left of the task you’d like to complete.

Enjoy themes on your watch

Add a pop of color to your wrist by using themes for Todoist.

You can’t change themes on your watch, but change your theme on any other platform and it’ll automatically update on your watch so you can stay coordinated.

Add the Day Progress tile

Add the Todoist Day Progress tile to your Wear OS device. It’s a tiny widget to track the day’s progress from your device’s home screen.

  • Open the Wear OS home screen.
  • Swipe right or left. You’ll see existing tiles or the default “Add a Tile” screen.
  • Touch and hold the screen. This turns on Editing mode.
  • Tap the + Add button. You’ll see a list of all tiles.
  • Scroll down and tap Day Progress.

Use Todoist complications on your watch face

Stay updated with Todoist at a glance by using any of the five available watch complications:

  • The Daily goal complication shows your progress towards your daily task goal with a circular progress bar around the number (the exact visual can vary from watchface to watchface).
  • The Weekly goal complication shows your progress towards your weekly task goal with a circular progress bar around the number (the exact visual can vary from watchface to watchface).
  • The Daily progress complication shows you how many tasks you’ve completed today out of all the tasks due. The progress is shown with a circular progress bar around the number (the exact visual can vary from watchface to watchface).
  • The Day summary complication shows you your next task due for the day, and how many more tasks you have to complete today.
  • The shortcut complication is simply a shortcut you can tap to open Todoist from your watch face. Quick tip

Need help setting up your watch complications? Here are some instructions from MakeUseOf

FAQ

You can install the Todoist app on watches running the Wear OS by Google. Devices running on OS from other manufacturers (Harmony OS, Color OS, Tizen, Zepp OS, Fitbit OS, etc) are not supported.

Clear Todoist cookies in the web browser

If there’s a technical issue with Todoist, and logging out and logging back in isn’t solving the issue, learn how to clear Todoist cookies on various web browsers:

Google Chrome

  • Copy and paste this address into your address bar: chrome://settings/privacy
  • Click Site settings.
  • Click View permissions and data stored across sites.
  • Enter Todoist in the search bar at the top-right.
  • Click the Delete displayed data button.
  • Click Delete to confirm.

Mozilla Firefox

  • Copy and paste this address into your address bar: about:preferences#privacy
  • In the Cookies and site data section, click the Manage data… button.
  • Enter Todoist in the search bar.
  • Click the Remove all button.

Safari

  • In the Safari app on your Mac, click Safari in the top-left.
  • Click Settings.
  • Click the Privacy tab.
  • Click Manage Website Data.
  • Enter Todoist in the search bar.
  • Click the Remove All button.

Microsoft Edge

  • Copy and paste this address into your address bar: edge://settings/content
  • In the Cookies and site permissions section, select Manage and delete cookies and site data.
  • Click See all cookies and site data.
  • Enter Todoist in the search bar.
  • Click Remove all shown.

Opera

  • Copy and paste this address into your address bar: opera://settings/privacy
  • In the Privacy and security section, click Cookies and other site data.
  • Click See all site data and permissions.
  • Enter Todoist in the search bar.
  • Click Delete displayed data.

Install Todoist for Windows as an MSIX app

If you downloaded Todoist for Windows from the Microsoft Store before October 2025, you can now switch to the new and improved Todoist desktop app. This MSIX-based version offers a smoother and more secure experience. Follow these steps to uninstall your current app and install the latest Todoist for Windows.

Understand the MSIX format

MSIX is a sandboxed format, which virtualizes filesystem and registry access, so that you can run Todoist in a more secure environment.

MSIX apps offer clean installs and uninstalls, and will have proper entries (for example: “Startup applications”) in your computer’s settings. This ensures a more streamlined setup and easier app management in Windows.

Install Todoist as an MSIX app

Note

If you need to continue using Todoist as a Win32 application, you can install this version from the Downloads page.

To use the MSIX version of Todoist for Windows, check if your computer runs on Windows 11. To ensure a smooth transition, you must first remove the old version of the app before installing the new one.

  • Uninstall the current Todoist app from your Windows computer.
  • Download and install the MSIX version from the Microsoft Store. The MSIX version removes all Todoist installation files automatically from your computer, so there’s nothing to clean up after.

Update the app

Once you’ve installed the MSIX version, you won’t need to manually check for updates. The app will update automatically through the Microsoft Store whenever a new version is released.

That’s it! You can continue using the Todoist you use and love.

Troubleshoot browser storage issues in Todoist

Todoist relies on stored information to load data quickly, preserve visual settings of the app, or let you use offline mode during your travels. To ensure that your work is safe, or that Todoist loads smoothly and consistently, the app needs access to browser storage to save this information on the computer. The data syncs to the Todoist servers as soon as you’re back online.

If there are sync errors or issues with browser storage, learn how to troubleshoot and resolve them.

Use a supported web browser

Use Todoist while on the latest version of a supported web browser. Learn more about the web browsers that work best with Todoist.

Enable access to browser storage

To use browser storage to save changes made offline, check if the web browser is set up to allow access:

  • Google Chrome: On-device site data
  • Mozilla Firefox: Manage local site storage settings
  • Safari: Give more space to website databases Warning

If you prefer to use Todoist without browser storage, make sure to work with a reliable internet connection. Without it, you may lose any offline data that isn’t synced to the Todoist servers.

Check the hard drive space

If there’s limited hard drive space on the computer, the web browser may free up space by removing stored information for some websites.

The latest web browsers are designed to know which stored information belongs to websites you use everyday; however, it’s best practice to make sure there’s enough hard drive space when working on tasks and projects offline.

Get in touch

If you’re experiencing issues with browser storage, or you’ve any questions about how Todoist data is stored in the browser, get in touch with us.

Troubleshoot performance issues with the Todoist desktop apps

The slightest visual glitch or two-second delay can quickly affect your productivity in Todoist. If you’re experiencing slowness, flickering, or any other performance-related issue with the desktop apps, follow the steps in this guide.

Use the latest version of Todoist

Version updates may include fixes and improvements to Todoist features. Here’s how to update the desktop apps to the latest version:

Select Platform:

If you’ve installed Todoist for macOS from the Downloads page, and there’s a new version, you’ll see an orange notification dot on your Todoist avatar. When you click your avatar, you’ll see a green line in the app menu to restart Todoist and update automatically.

If you installed Todoist from the Mac App Store, it handles all the updates for you. Here’s how to manually update the app.

If you need to fully uninstall the app before updating to the latest version, follow these steps.

Right-click the Todoist icon in the system tray. Then, select Quit Todoist. The new version will automatically be installed once the app is closed.

If you need to manually reinstall and update Todoist for Windows, follow these steps.

If you need to manually reinstall Todoist for Linux to get the latest version, follow these steps.

Update your operating system

Similar to Todoist, new versions of your operating system may include feature improvements, security fixes, and more.

Select Platform:

Check the system requirements to see if you’re using the minimum required version to run Todoist for macOS. If it’s an older version, follow these instructions to update macOS to the latest version.

Check the system requirements to see if you’re using the minimum required version to run Todoist for Windows. If it’s an older version, follow these instructions to update Windows to the latest version.

Check the system requirements to see if you’re using the minimum required version to run Todoist for Linux. If it’s an older version, follow these instructions to update your Ubuntu server to the latest version.

Log out and log back in to Todoist

Log out of the Todoist desktop app to remove outdated or corrupted website elements, including cache or cookies. Then, log back in and see if performance improves when using the app.

Clear application data

If you’re seeing visual issues or are having trouble logging in to Todoist, here’s how to clear application data to remove any cached pages or scripts:

Select Platform:

  • Open Todoist for macOS.

  • Click Todoist in the main menu at the top-left.

  • Select Clear application data. Todoist for macOS will restart and the login page will appear.

  • Open Todoist for Windows.

  • Click the down arrow of the Windows tray menu at the bottom-right.

  • Right-click the Todoist app icon.

  • Select Clear application data. Todoist for Windows will restart and the login page will appear.

  • Open Todoist for Linux.

  • Right-click the Todoist app icon.

  • Select Clear application data. Todoist for Linux will restart and the login page will appear.

Disable hardware acceleration

If you’re seeing visual glitches in the desktop apps, you can disable hardware acceleration to see if it improves performance. This is especially helpful when using Todoist for Linux if the app isn’t able to utilize the video card properly. You may, however, notice how in-app animations are not as sharp as they were before.

Select Platform:

  • Open Todoist for macOS.
  • Click Help in the main app menu.
  • Hover your cursor over Troubleshooting.
  • Select Disable hardware acceleration and restart.
  • Open Todoist for Windows.
  • Click the down arrow of the Windows tray menu at the bottom-right.
  • Right-click the Todoist app icon.
  • Hover your cursor over Troubleshooting.
  • Select Disable hardware acceleration and restart.
  • Open Todoist for Linux.
  • Right-click the Todoist app icon.
  • Hover your cursor over Troubleshooting.
  • Select Disable hardware acceleration and restart.

Menu bar icon not appearing

If the Todoist icon is missing from the menu bar on macOS, make sure it’s enabled in the app’s settings:

  • Open Todoist for macOS.
  • Open Settings, then go to Desktop.
  • Turn on Show Todoist in menu bar. Note

On macOS 26 Tahoe, if the icon still doesn’t appear after enabling it in Todoist, open System Settings, go to Menu Bar, find Allow in the Menu Bar, and turn on Todoist.

Uninstall Todoist for macOS

When troubleshooting bugs or crash-related issues with Todoist for macOS, you may need to uninstall the app. To uninstall Todoist for macOS and remove all installation files, follow these steps:

Quit Todoist processes

  • On the Mac, open the Activity Monitor app.
  • Click the magnifying glass to open the search bar.
  • Enter Todoist.
  • Press ⌘ Command and click to select all related processes.
  • Click the hexagon stop icon to quit the processes. This will remove them from the list. If there are no Todoist processes running in Activity Monitor, continue to the next step.

Uninstall Todoist for macOS

After making sure there are no pending processes running, uninstall Todoist for macOS:

  • Open the Applications folder of the Mac.
  • Drag Todoist for macOS to the Trash.
  • Empty the Trash.

Remove Todoist application files

Step 1: Remove Application Support data

After uninstalling Todoist for macOS, remove the application files:

  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Click Go to Folder and enter the following file path:
  • ~/Library/Application Support/Todoist
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Find the Todoist folder and delete it.
Step 2: Remove preferences
  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Select Go to Folder and enter the following file path:
  • ~/Library/Preferences/
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Find the file com.todoist.mac.Todoist or any other file that contains com.todoist. Then, select them and press ⌫ Delete.
Step 3: Remove Saved Application State file
  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Select Go to Folder and enter the following file path:
  • ~/Library/Saved Application State/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.savedState
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Find the file com.todoist.mac.Todoist.savedState. Then, select the file and press ⌫ Delete.
Step 4: Remove cache files
  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Select Go to Folder and enter the following file path:
  • ~/Library/Caches/
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Find file directories that contain com.todoist. If there are Todoist file directories, select them and press ⌫ Delete.
Step 5: Remove logs
  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Select Go to Folder and enter the following file path:
  • ~/Library/Logs/
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Find the Todoist directory. Then, press ⌫ Delete.
Step 6: Remove application scripts
  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Select Go to Folder and enter the following file paths:
  • ~/Library/Application Scripts/com.todoist.mac.Todoist
  • ~/Library/Application Scripts/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.TodoistShare
  • ~/Library/Application Scripts/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.TodoistWidgets
  • ~/Library/Application Scripts/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.TodoistSafari
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Select these files and press ⌫ Delete.
Step 7: Remove container files
  • Open a Finder window.
  • Click Go from the main menu.
  • Select Go to Folder and enter the following file paths:
  • ~/Library/Containers/com.todoist.mac.Todoist
  • ~/Library/Containers/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.TodoistSafari
  • ~/Library/Containers/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.TodoistShare
  • ~/Library/Containers/com.todoist.mac.Todoist.TodoistWidgets
  • Press ↵ Return.
  • Select these files and press ⌫ Delete.
Step 8: Remove keychain data
  • Open Keychain Access in the Utilities folder. When the prompt to open passwords or Keychain Access appears, choose Keychain Access.
  • Enter Todoist in the search bar on the top-right.
  • Select and delete the Todoist Safe Storage and com.todoist.mac.Todoist entries.

Reinstall Todoist for macOS

After deleting the Todoist application files, empty the Trash and restart the macOS device. Then, download and install Todoist for macOS.

Use Todoist as a native Wayland application

If your computer is running on Wayland, you may see some graphical glitches in Todoist caused by XWayland. These may include blurred fonts or scaling issues when using multiple screens.

Although Wayland isn’t officially supported, and that bugs may occur, you can run Todoist as a native Wayland application without the XWayland layer:

Use Snap to run Todoist on Wayland

  • Open a terminal.
  • Enter this command to start Todoist: snap run todoist --ozone-platform-hint=auto
  • Copy the Todoist .desktop file from /var/lib/snapd/desktop/applications.
  • Paste it to the following location: ~/.local/share/applications
  • Edit its Exec line to add the following: --ozone-platform-hint=auto

Use AppImage to run Todoist on Wayland

  • Open a terminal.
  • Find the name of the Todoist AppImage file by entering this command: ls ~/Applications/Todoist-*.AppImage
  • Start Todoist using the name of that file: ~/Applications/Todoist-<filename>.AppImage --ozone-platform-hint=auto
  • Edit the Todoist .desktop file in your desktop environment by adding the following to its Exec line: --ozone-platform-hint=auto

Get in touch

If you’re still having trouble running Todoist as a native Wayland application, get in touch with us. We—Omar, Evert, Rachel, or any of our other teammates—will make sure this gets sorted out for you.

Use Doify with Todoist

Doify is a Todoist automation tool that lets you create custom rules to handle repetitive actions and streamline your workflow. Each rule combines a trigger (something that happens in Todoist) with an action (what Doify does in response).

For example:

  • When a task is completed, move it to a “Done” section
  • When a task becomes overdue, reschedule it to today
  • When a label is assigned, move the task to a different project

Set up the integration

  • Go to app.doify.io and sign in with your Todoist account.
  • Create your first rule. Note

The Free plan includes 3 custom rules – a good way to try Doify out before upgrading.

Create a rule

  • From the rules page, click Create rule.
  • Choose a trigger (the event in Todoist that starts the rule).
  • Choose an action (what Doify does when the trigger fires).
  • Save the rule. Once created, rules run automatically in the background.

Available triggers

  • Task created: fires when a new task is added to Todoist
  • Task completed: fires when a task is marked as complete
  • Task is overdue: fires when a task passes its due date without being completed
  • Task reaches due date: fires when a task reaches its due date or time
  • Assign a label: fires when a specific label is added to a task
  • Add a date: fires when a due date is added to a task
  • Remove a date: fires when a due date is removed from a task
  • Enter a section: fires when a task moves into a specified section
  • Leave a section: fires when a task moves out of a specified section

Available actions

  • Move to project section: moves the task to a specified section within a project
  • Move to project: moves the task to a different project
  • Move to parent task: makes the task a subtask of another specified task
  • Add label: assigns a label to the task
  • Remove label: removes a label from the task
  • Remove date: removes the due date from the task
  • Remove deadline: removes the deadline from the task
  • Reschedule to current date: reschedules the task to today, keeping any time already set
  • Ensure subtasks completed: marks the parent task as incomplete if any subtask is still open. Can only be used with the Task completed trigger
  • Complete task: marks the task as complete Note

Members of the Pro plan can use sub-task sorting to quickly sort the sub-tasks of a task by name, priority, due date, or deadline.

Example rules

Here are a few examples to give you a sense of what’s possible:

Rule

Trigger

Automation

Kanban board automation

Task completed

Move to the “Done” section

Someday/maybe list

Assign the “Someday” label

Remove date and deadline

Overdue task rollover

Task is overdue

Reschedule to current date

Label sync

Enter a section called “In Progress”

Add the “In Progress” label

New task defaults

Task created

Assign a label

Use Evernote and Todoist Connection with IFTTT

IFTTT Connections is an evolution of the IFTTT Applets. Unlike Applets, which are limited to simple “if this then that” triggers and actions, Connections allow entire integrations between services, and can therefore power multiple queries, triggers, and actions at the same time.

The Evernote and Todoist Connection will help you stay organized by creating new Todoist tasks whenever an Evernote note with a specific tag is added. It’ll also create new Evernote notes when Todoist tasks with a specific label are created.

Set up the integration

  • Open Todoist’s IFTTT Channel and activate it in your IFTTT account.
  • Select the Sync Evernote and Todoist connection.
  • Select Connect Evernote.
  • Follow the instructions on the screen to add the Connection.
  • Select Save.

Remove the integration

  • Open the Integrations tab.
  • Click the X icon next to the IFTTT integration.
  • Click OK to confirm.

Use IFTTT with Todoist

IFTTT (If This Then That) lets you create powerful connections or “applets” between Todoist and various apps or services. With IFTTT, you can save your completed tasks in Google Sheets or create a new task automatically when a GitHub issue is assigned to you.

Quick tip

Explore Todoist IFTTT applets created by users.

Set up the integration

  • Open Todoist’s IFTTT Channel and activate it in your IFTTT account.
  • Open an applet that you’d like to activate.
  • Click the Connect toggle.
  • Follow the on-screen instructions to create an IFTTT account.
  • Click Save.

Use the integration

Link your Todoist account with over 200 different channels including Pocket, Evernote, Facebook, Slack, Twitter, Fitbit, and many more.

Quick tip

You can now choose tasks from specific sections as the applet triggers, as well as make the IFTTT integration add new tasks to your selected projects and sections.

Limitations with the integration

There are a few limitations to consider when using the IFTTT integration:

  • Lack of support for recurring dates: IFTTT captures the new date, rather than the date as it was when the recurring task was completed. This would also happen if you complete a task before its scheduled date on a regular or recurring task.
  • Slow sync: With the current IFTTT infrastructure, it may take a while for tasks and notes to sync with Todoist.

Remove the integration

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Open the Integrations tab.
  • Click the dismiss icon next to the IFTTT integration.
  • Click OK to confirm.

Use Zoho Flow with Todoist

Zoho is a suite of software that’s designed to help businesses thrive. It has several platforms that can improve your organization’s workflows, one of which is Zoho Flow.

By integrating Zoho Flow with Todoist, you’ll be able to set up automated actions between Todoist and other platforms.

Quick tip

To learn more about how to use Zoho Flow with Todoist, visit the Zoho Flow help center.

Setting up the integration

  • Access your Zoho Flow account, or create an account if you do not already have one.
  • Create your first flow by clicking Create Flow or the + button.
  • Give a name to your flow and write a description.
  • Click Create. You can now customize your flow.
  • Click Configure next to App.
  • Search for and select Todoist.
  • Select what action will trigger your flow (such as completing a task or creating a new project), and click Next.
  • If this is your first time using Todoist and Zoho Flow together, you’ll be asked to authorize a connection to your Todoist account:
    • Click Connect.
    • Add a name for your connection (such as My Todoist).
    • Choose whether you want the connection to execute All triggers and actions or Only specific triggers and actions.
    • Click Authorize in the bottom-right corner.
    • A pop-up window will appear. Click Agree.
  • You will now see a list of options you can use to customize your trigger. Once you’re happy with your trigger, click Done in the bottom-right corner.
  • You will now see a board that has your trigger on it. In the left-hand menu, select an action that you would like to automate and drag-and-drop it onto the board.
    • For example, you can scroll down to Todoist, open the dropdown menu list of actions and select Create a project. If you drag this option onto the board, you will have set it up so that whenever your trigger is triggered, a new project will be created in your Todoist.
  • You can add several actions to your board, so that once your trigger is activated, several automated actions can happen at once.

How to remove the integration

  • Log in to your Zoho Flow account.
  • Open Settings in the left-hand menu.
  • Select Connections.
  • Find your Todoist connection and hover your mouse over it.
  • Click the trash can icon in the right-hand side of the screen.
  • Confirm you wish to delete the connection by clicking Delete. Quick tip

You can also use Zoho Mail and Zoho Cliq with Todoist. Have a look at the below articles to learn more:

Request a refund

After you’ve canceled your Todoist subscription, you could be eligible for a refund. Keep in mind that when you cancel your subscription, you’ll be back on the Beginner plan. Here’s what happens when you downgrade.

Monthly subscriptions

Monthly payments for Pro and Business plans aren’t refundable when you cancel, unless a refund is required by consumer protection laws in your country.

If you cancel a monthly subscription, you’ll be able to use the paid features until the end of the billing cycle. You won’t be charged at the next renewal date.

Yearly Pro subscription

If you cancel your yearly Pro plan within 30 days of purchase or renewal, you’re eligible for a full refund.

Quick tip

Purchased via Todoist website? You can self-serve a refund for your yearly subscription from your subscription settings.

Via the Todoist website

You can process this refund yourself. It’s fully self-serve:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select Subscription.
  • Click Cancel plan.
  • Choose a reason for canceling. You can also share feedback on what we could improve.
  • Click Cancel subscription to confirm.
  • Select End the subscription immediately and receive a refund.
  • Click Cancel subscription to finalize and process the refund. Note

If you’re outside the 30-day refund window, you’ll only see the option to cancel at the end of your billing period.

Via Google Play

If you purchased a yearly subscription through Google Play, first cancel your Pro subscription using these instructions. Then contact us to request a refund for your yearly payment.

Via the App Store

If you purchased your yearly Pro subscription via the App Store, contact Apple directly for your refund. Apple doesn’t allow any developers to process refunds for App Store purchases.

Via the Microsoft Store

Microsoft doesn’t offer refunds for purchases made via their store. You can learn more in Microsoft Store’s Terms of Sale.

Yearly Business subscription

If you purchased a yearly Business subscription within the last 30 days, cancel your Business team first, then contact us to request a refund. Include your payment receipt or the order reference ID from your invoice.

Note

If you’re not eligible for a Business subscription refund, you may have credit on your account after canceling your subscription. This credit isn’t refundable.

Note

FAQ

Can I get a refund for a yearly subscription after the 30-day window?

If you purchased your subscription through the Todoist website or the Google Play Store, refunds for yearly subscriptions are only available within 30 days of the original purchase or renewal date. Refund requests made after this 30-day period aren’t eligible for a refund.

If you purchased through the App Store, contact Apple directly. Apple manages all subscriptions and refunds for App Store purchases.

Todoist Partner Programs

The Todoist Partner Programs reward content creators, publishers, bloggers, coaches, and productivity experts for introducing Todoist to new users. We have multiple programs that empower different types of channel partners to grow with Todoist.

If you think your audience or network aligns with Todoist’s mission to help people organize their work and life, read more below to see if this program is a fit for you!

How to apply to become a Todoist Partner

To apply, simply visit our partner page and click Start Your Application. You’ll get an email confirming that we’ve received your application and hear from our team within 5 working days.

If your application is approved, we’ll help you create a PartnerStack account (if you haven’t already), welcome you into the program, and then you’re ready to go!

Note

Please note that PartnerStack is only available in English and all communication you’ll receive from PartnerStack will be in English.

How the Partner Program works

As a Todoist Partner, you’ll have your own unique Todoist referral link which you can share with your audience or network. When someone clicks your referral link, and if they upgrade within the next 90 days, we’ll thank you with a reward!

Here’s how rewards are calculated:

Yearly plans

You will get a commission of up to 25% (this depends on your partner tier). You can only earn one reward per user that upgrades using your link. Furthermore, you can only get the reward for accounts that upgrade from the Beginner plan to a paid plan (and therefore not on renewals).

Monthly plans

You can get a commission of up to 25% for up to 12 payments (this depends on your partner tier). The monetary value of your reward may differ depending on the currency of the purchase itself, but the commission percentage will remain the same.

FAQ

The partner program is designed for people or organizations who are passionate about Todoist and have a sizeable existing audience who may find Todoist beneficial to their life or work. Whether you’re a blogger, productivity coach, social influencer, agency, publication, or something in between, we encourage you to apply if you feel you meet these criteria. Your application will determine which of our partner programs is best suited to you.

We review applications on a weekly basis and will respond within 5 working days.

You can find the many benefits of our partner programs on our partner page.

We use PartnerStack, a third-party platform, to manage our Todoist partner program. With PartnerStack, you can:

  • Create a PartnerStack account
  • Apply to the Todoist Partner Program
  • Generate a unique Todoist referral link
  • Track clicks and new Todoist Pro/Todoist Business upgrades from your audience
  • View and redeem your rewards
  • Manage your earnings As a partner, you’ll have your own unique referral link to share with your audience. When someone clicks on your link, a cookie is saved in that person’s browser which will last for 90 days. If the person becomes a paid Todoist user within that 90-day period, that sale will be attributed to you. We’ll even count that sale as yours if the referred person leaves the site and comes back later without clicking your referral link again. And if that person doesn’t become a paid user in 90 days, but clicks your referral link again, the 90 days will restart.

A cookie is a teeny amount of information that a website can leave in your browser. That way, if you go back to that site, it remembers you. In this case, your unique Todoist referral link will allow PartnerStack to attribute any paid upgrades from that link to you so we can thank you with a reward.

You’ll earn rewards from the first to the last day of a month. You can monitor the rewards you accumulate in your PartnerStack account under Pending Rewards. You can redeem rewards that are outside of the refund period — which is 30 days long. Since Todoist upgrades within 30 days of the purchase date are eligible for a full refund, we make sure to wait to reward you until that period is over. Please review PartnerStack FAQs for up-to-date payment terms.

Please review PartnerStack FAQs for up-to-date payment terms.

All payments are done in USD. If your bank account is using a different currency (like EUR), the transferred amount is subject to your bank’s currency exchange or fees and will be converted to your bank account’s currency upon arriving in your account.

We only keep track of purchases made through todoist.com. Therefore, purchases made via the App Store or Google Play will not be eligible for rewards. That’s why your unique link will direct users to the Todoist registration page in a browser.

VAT-exempt invoices and payments for Todoist

Save some money on your plan renewal by getting value-added tax (VAT) exemption for payments made through the Todoist website.

Warning

VAT exemption is only possible for payments made in EUR, DKK, SEK, or GBP, and for companies that are registered in either the European Union or United Kingdom.

About VAT for the Pro plan

For customers based in the USA and Canada, taxes like VAT are calculated and added at checkout.

Apart from making sure pricing is predictable, EU and UK-based customers pay exactly what is shown on the Todoist pricing page. Here’s a breakdown:

  • No VAT ID: your invoice displays the words tax included. VAT is included in the total amount, and it’s automatically collected and remitted to the appropriate tax authorities.
  • With a VAT ID: your invoice displays the words reverse charge and no VAT is charged on your invoice; instead, it’s handled separately based on your country’s tax regulations. Note

The tax status change from taxable to reverse charge doesn’t happen automatically, as the Pro plan is set for personal usage. If you need your tax status changed, contact us.

Add VAT ID when upgrading to the Pro plan

To add the VAT ID directly when upgrading to the Pro plan:

  • Log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click the Subscription tab.
  • Click Upgrade to Pro. You’ll see the checkout page.
  • Fill in your email address and your payment card details.
  • Select I’m purchasing as a business.
  • Enter your VAT information.

Add VAT ID for an existing Pro plan

To display your VAT ID in future invoices and qualify for VAT exemption, add the VAT ID and billing address to the Todoist account before the renewal.

  • Log in to the Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Click Settings.
  • Click Subscription.
  • Click Go to Billing.
  • Click Update information under the Billing Information section.
  • Add the billing address and VAT ID.
  • Click Save to confirm. Note

If you upgraded through an in-app purchase with Apple or Google, contact the appropriate vendor for any VAT-related request.

About VAT for the Business plan

The Todoist Business plan is tax-exclusive. When a valid VAT ID is added to your team’s billing information, the invoice displays the words reverse charge and no VAT will be charged. If no VAT ID is added, the invoice displays the words taxable, and the total amount will include applicable VAT or sales tax.

Add VAT ID when upgrading to the Business plan

Admins alone can edit billing information for Todoist teams. If you’re an admin, here’s how to add the VAT ID when upgrading to the Business plan:

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Scroll down to your team workspace.
  • Click Billing.
  • Click Upgrade to Business. You’ll see the checkout page.
  • Fill in your email address and your card details.
  • Select I’m purchasing as a business.
  • Enter your VAT information.

Add a VAT ID to an existing Business plan

Admins alone can edit billing information for Todoist teams. If you’re an admin, here’s how to add the VAT ID to your existing Business plan:

  • Log in to the Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Click Settings.
  • Scroll down to your team workspace.
  • Click Billing.
  • Click Manage Billing.
  • Click Update information under the Billing Information section.
  • Add the billing address and VAT ID.
  • Click Save to confirm.

What happens when I downgrade my plan?

If you downgrade from a paid plan to the Beginner plan, you’ll lose access to certain features and revert to lower account limits. Here’s what to expect when you downgrade your paid plan:

  • You’ll only have up to 5 active projects.
  • You’ll only have up to 3 custom filters.
  • You’ll have access to 7 days’ worth of Reporting history.
  • Todoist will no longer generate backups automatically, and you won’t be able to create new ones. You can review what you’ll get with the paid plan versus the Beginner plan in this article and on our pricing page.

Usage limits and access to paid features

When you downgrade from Business to Pro, you can have up to 5 team projects. If you have more than 5 team projects when you downgrade, any team projects over the limit will become frozen (read-only).

Frozen team projects cannot be edited and you will not be able to add any new tasks to them. However, you can still view these projects, and you can delete or archive them.

To unfreeze a frozen team project, move it from your team to My Projects. Once moved, the project will become active again and you’ll be able to edit it.

If you are above the free project limit when you downgrade, any project that goes above the free limit will become view-only projects.

A view-only project cannot be edited and you will not be able to add any new tasks to it. However, you can still delete or archive the project.

Todoist will automatically make projects view-only according to the creation date.

For example, if you are on the Pro plan with 10 personal projects and you then downgrade to the Beginner plan (which has a limit of 5 personal projects), your 5 oldest projects will become view-only.

No, Todoist will automatically make projects view-only according to the creation date.

View-only projects will be marked with an exclamation mark icon in your sidebar. Furthermore, if you open a view-only project, you will see a banner which will identify it as a view-only project.

You can either upgrade to a paid plan or bring your account under the free project limit by archiving or deleting projects.

On the Beginner plan, you can have up to 3 custom filters. When you downgrade, your filter data will be retained, however, you won’t be able to view the filter content until you upgrade to a paid subscription.

When you downgrade to the Beginner plan, all your task-related data will be retained, but you won’t be able to add or edit features like task duration, custom reminders, deadlines, and member roles (in workspaces). However, you will be able to remove them as long as the task is part of an active project that isn’t view-only.

Once you downgrade, you’ll be able to view your Reporting history for the past 7 days. All your Reporting history becomes available again as soon as you resubscribe.

Backups will no longer be generated automatically, and you won’t be able to create new ones. You will still have access to up to 21 backups that were created before canceling.

This depends on your account:

  • If you are the one downgrading, the project may become view-only for you (depending on how old the project is and how many projects you have in your account).
  • If your collaborator downgrades their plan, and you remain on the paid plan, you’ll still have full access to the project, while the project may become view-only for your collaborator. This will depend on how old the project is and how many projects they have in their account. Yes, these tasks will still be included in your filters.

No, you won’t be able to specifically filter for view-only projects. That being said, you can see in your sidebar which projects are view-only.

Yes, you’ll still receive reminders that were added before you downgraded your plan.

Yes. Seeing as your collaborator is using the project as an active project, they can still perform actions which you might get notifications for.

Business plan trials

Yes, you can create a second team while your first team is on the Business plan trial.

If you have paid for Pro and you start a Business plan trial before using your full Pro time, your remaining Pro time will be added as credit in our system. However, please note that this credit can only be used to pay for Pro subscriptions.

Your team will stay on the Business plan trial until the trial period is finished.

The same team can only go through one Business plan trial. If you set up a second team, you can start a new Business plan trial for it.

Use Firefox with Todoist

If you’re looking to optimize the workflow between Todoist and Firefox, this Todoist extension is for you!

Installation

Install the Todoist extension in your browser here.

How to use the extension

To get a quick look at Todoist from your browser, click the Todoist icon in your extensions bar in the top right. A compact view of Todoist will appear:

The compact view is a great way to save time: You can access any of Todoist’s features without having to leave your current web page.

  • Go to the website you’d like to add as a task.

  • Right-click anywhere on the page and select Add to Todoist. A pop-up window opens where you can add task details.

  • Make any other changes, such as choosing a project, adding a label, or assigning a date and time.

  • Click Add task to save the task. You can add the current website as a task directly from your task list in the extension:

  • Click the Todoist icon in your extensions bar in the top right.

  • Click Add website as task at the end of your task list. The page title and URL are added as the task name.

  • Click Add task to save the task. Spot a quote or a paragraph you want to save to Todoist? Here’s how to capture it as a task:

  • Open the website where you found the text you want to capture.

  • Select the text on the page.

  • Right-click the selected text and choose Add to Todoist. This opens Quick Add in a pop-up window, with the selected text as the task name.

  • Make any other changes, such as choosing a project, adding a label, or assigning a date and time.

  • Click Add task to save the task.

  • Open Firefox.

  • Right-click the Todoist icon in the top-right corner.

  • Select Manage Extension.

  • Click the gear icon in the top-right corner.

  • Select Manage Extension Shortcuts.

  • You can now set a keyboard shortcut for adding a task.

  • Open Firefox.

  • Right-click the Todoist icon in the top-right corner.

  • Select Manage Extension.

  • Click the gear icon in the top-left corner.

  • Open the tab Preferences.

  • Click the checkbox to the left of Set default due date for ‘Today’.

Installation

  • Click the checkbox next to it. With the Chrome extension, you can turn emails into Todoist tasks or open these same emails through Todoist. Find the steps to do so here.

Troubleshoot the extension

If you run into any errors or technical issues while using the Todoist for Chrome extension, check this section for the troubleshooting steps.

Todoist can’t access Gmail due to cookie settings

If you see a TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'name') error when trying to create a task from Gmail, the extension can’t access Gmail properly due to Chrome’s cookie settings.

To resolve this, add Todoist to the allowed sites list with these steps:

  • Open Google Chrome and go to Settings > Privacy and security > Third-party cookies.
  • Scroll to the bottom and click Add under the allowed sites list.
  • Enter [*.]todoist.com and click Add.
  • Click Add again, enter mail.google.com, and click Add.
  • Restart Google Chrome.
  • Sign in at app.todoist.com and try creating a task from Gmail again.

  • Click the Todoist icon in your extensions bar in the top-right.
  • Click Add website as task at the end of your task list. This adds the web page title and URL as the task name.
  • Click Add task to save the task.

Use Todoist in Safari

Save any web page as a Todoist task using the Todoist button for Safari.

Set up the extension

  • Install Todoist for macOS.
  • Make sure the extension is enabled in your browser’s settings.
    • Open Safari.
    • Click Safari at the top-left.
    • Select Settings.
    • Open the Extensions tab.
    • Check if Todoist is turned on.
  • Next, add the Todoist button in Safari:
    • Open Safari.
    • Click View at the top-left.
    • Select Customize Toolbar….
    • Find the Todoist icon and drag it either to the left or right side of the address bar.
    • Click Done.

Use the extension

Once you’ve set up the extension, add any website as a Todoist task:

  • Click the Todoist icon in the toolbar. Quick Add will appear with the link to the website in the task name.
  • Add any relevant information to the task name or description.
  • Click Add task to save the task.

Calendars

Add a Todoist calendar feed

See all your scheduled Todoist tasks inside your favorite calendar app.

When a Todoist calendar feed is added to the calendar:

  • Tasks in personal projects or shared projects where you’re a collaborator will appear.
  • Tasks with a date but without a time will appear as all-day events.
  • Tasks with a date and time will appear as one-hour events.
  • Tasks with a date and task duration will appear as events with the same duration.
  • Completed tasks are removed from the feed and won’t appear on your calendar.

Add an account calendar feed

The account calendar feed syncs all tasks with a date, time, and task duration across all projects. In doing so, a new “Todoist” calendar is created automatically in your calendar app of choice. Here’s how to set it up:

Copy the account calendar feed

Select Platform:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select the Integrations tab.
  • Scroll down to the Calendar Subscription URL (iCal) section.
  • Click Copy link beside the calendar subscription URL. It’s not possible to subscribe to a calendar feed using the Todoist mobile apps. Switch to the Todoist web or desktop apps, and follow the instructions to subscribe to a Todoist calendar feed first. The “Todoist” calendar will sync with your mobile calendar app as well.
Subscribe to the account calendar feed

After copying the calendar feed, here’s how to subscribe to the feed depending on which calendar app you’d like to use:

  • Open the Apple Calendar app.
  • Click File at the top.
  • Select New Calendar Subscription…
  • Paste the calendar URL you copied in Todoist.
  • Click Subscribe.
  • Select the Auto-refresh rate.
  • Select OK.
  • Open Outlook Calendar.
  • Select your calendar in the menu.
  • Click Add Calendar.
  • Click Subscribe from web.
  • Paste the calendar subscription link from Todoist.
  • Give the calendar a name. You can also select a calendar color and icon.
  • Click Import.
  • Open Google Calendar.
  • Find the Other calendars section on the left side.
  • Click the plus icon below My Calendars.
  • Select From URL and follow the on-screen instructions to add the new calendar.

Add a project calendar feed

The project calendar feed creates a one-way sync between a specific Todoist project and your calendar. A new calendar is created for each project you subscribe to in your calendar app. Here’s how to set it up:

Copy the project calendar feed

Select Platform:

  • Open the project you want to view in your calendar.
  • Click the three dots icon at the top-right.
  • Select Project calendar feed.
  • Click Copy link to copy the project calendar feed. If you need to refresh the feed, click Generate new feed first.
  • Open Safari for iOS.
  • Log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com
  • Open the project you want to view in your calendar.
  • Tap the three dots icon at the top-right.
  • Select Project calendar feed.
  • Tap Copy link to copy the project calendar feed. If you need to refresh the feed, tap Generate new feed first.
  • Open the Settings app on your iOS device.
  • Scroll down and tap Mail > Accounts.
  • Tap Add Account > Other.
  • Select Add Subscribed Calendar and paste in the URL you copied earlier.
  • Tap Next at the top-right.
  • Rename the calendar if you like, then tap Save. When you open the Apple Calendar app on your iOS device to view your available calendars, you’ll now see the newly added iCal feed subscription in the Subscribed section of your calendar.

It’s not possible to copy a project calendar feed using Todoist for Android; however, you can still copy the feed through the mobile web browser, and by following the instructions for the web or desktop apps.

Subscribe to the project calendar feed

After copying the project calendar feed, here’s how to subscribe to it depending on which calendar app you’d like to use:

  • Open the Apple Calendar app.
  • Click File at the top.
  • Select New Calendar Subscription…
  • Paste the calendar URL you copied in Todoist.
  • Click Subscribe.
  • Select the Auto-refresh rate.
  • Select OK.
  • Open Outlook Calendar.
  • Select your calendar in the menu.
  • Click Add Calendar.
  • Click Subscribe from web.
  • Paste the calendar subscription link from Todoist.
  • Give the calendar a name. You can also select a calendar color and icon.
  • Click Import.
  • Open Google Calendar.
  • Find the Other calendars section on the left side.
  • Click the plus icon below My Calendars.
  • Select From URL and follow the on-screen instructions to add the new calendar. Evert · Head of Customer Experience

Share project calendar feeds with coworkers, clients, family, or friends! This helps keep them in the loop with what you’re working on, and what’s due soon.

About the refresh rate of your calendar feed

How often your calendar feed refreshes depends on the calendar app you use. Some calendar apps update as often as every 5 minutes, whereas others update only once per day.

Apple Calendar is the only app that lets you manually refresh your calendar feed. If you’re using Apple Calendar for macOS, press ⌘ + R. If you’re using Apple Calendar for iOS, tap Calendars at the bottom of the screen. Then, pull down the screen to refresh the calendar.

If you’ve added tasks with recurring dates to the project, the Todoist calendar feed only shows the first seven occurrences of these tasks in your calendar. As you get through your week, the calendar feed displays the rest of the occurrences over time.

Turn off all calendar feeds

If you need to turn off all Todoist calendar feeds, issue a new API token:

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Integrations.
  • Select the Developer tab.
  • Click Issue a new API token. You’ll be logged out from all devices authorized to access the Todoist account.

Remove the Todoist calendar from your calendar app

If you still see Todoist in your calendar app, follow the steps to remove it using the appropriate support article below:

  • Apple Calendar: Add or delete calendars on Mac
  • Google Calendar: Delete or unsubscribe from a calendar
  • Outlook Calendar: Delete a calendar

Use Fantastical with Todoist

Fantastical is a calendar app for iOS.

With this integration, you’ll be able to see all your tasks from Todoist directly in Fantastical, and any changes you make to Todoist tasks in Fantastical will sync back to Todoist and vice versa.

Setting up the integration

Select Platform:

  • In Fantastical, select Preferences.
  • Click on the Accounts tab.
  • Click on the + button.
  • From the account type list, select Todoist and sign in to your Todoist account.
  • Open Fantastical’s settings by tapping on the calendar icon in the top-left of the screen.
  • Tap on Settings.
  • Select Accounts.
  • Tap on Add Account.
  • From the account type list, select Todoist and sign in to your Todoist account.

Using the integration

See all your Todoist tasks in Fantastical’s task view

Here’s how to access this view:

Select Platform:

At the bottom left, click on the checkmark icon.

Quick tip

You can also open the task view by using the Command + R shortcut.

iPhone

Open the DayTicker in Fantastical and swipe up to open the task view.

iPad

Tap the checkmark icon at the top of the screen.

Adding tasks in Fantastical

Quickly and easily create new Todoist tasks right from within your Fantastical Calendar using natural language.

Select Platform:

  • In the top left of Fantastical, click on the + button to open the event creation field.
  • By default, Fantastical will create a calendar event when you begin typing in the event creation field, but there are two ways you can instruct Fantastical to create a task instead:
    • In the event creation window which opens when you start typing in the task creation field, click on the toggle slider.
    • Start a sentence by typing ‘task’, ‘todo’, or ‘reminder’ to create a task instead of a calendar event.
  • Next, type your task name and add other task details such as the task’s due date or due time.
  • Click on Add Task to save the task.
  • In the bottom left, tap the + button to open the event creation screen.
  • By default, Fantastical will create a calendar event when you begin typing but there are two ways you can instruct Fantastical to create a task instead:
    • In the event creation window which opens when you start typing in the task creation field, tap on the toggle slider.
    • Alternatively, you can start a sentence by typing ‘task’, ‘todo’, or ‘reminder’ to create a task instead of a calendar event.
  • Next, type your task name and add other task details such as the task’s due date or due time.
  • Tap on Add to save the task.

Using Fantastical Shortcuts

Specifying your task’s Todoist project in Fantastical

In Fantastical, you can specify which Todoist project you’d like to add your new task to by typing a / (slash) in the event creation window, followed by the name of the project. For example, type /Home to add the task to your #Home project in Todoist.

Adding a priority level to your task

In Fantastical, you can quickly set the priority of a new task by typing exclamation points ! into the event creation window. Type ! (one exclamation point) to add P3, type !! (two exclamation points) to add P2, and !!! (three exclamation points) to add P1 to your task.

FAQ

This integration is managed by Flexibits. Please contact the Flexibits support team for help.

If you no longer want to use Todoist with Fantastical, here’s how to remove the integration:

  • In Fantastical, select Preferences.
  • Click on the Accounts tab.
  • In the menu to the left, select your Todoist account.
  • At the bottom left, click the - button.
  • In the pop-up window that opens, click on Remove Account to confirm.
  • At the top left of Fantastical, tap the menu icon.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select Accounts.
  • Tap on your Todoist account.
  • In the next screen, select Remove Account to confirm.

Use the Calendar integration

The Calendar integration enables you to see your Google or Outlook Calendar events alongside your tasks in the Today and Upcoming views, making it easier to plan your day and week. It also lets you sync your time-blocked tasks to Google or Outlook Calendar to mirror your schedule.

Running into sync issues? See the troubleshooting guides for Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar.

Note

The Calendar integration is available on all three Todoist plans: Beginner, Pro, and Business. Connecting Google or Outlook Calendar, viewing your events in Todoist, and syncing your tasks to your calendar are available on every plan. The calendar layout, which lets you time-block tasks in a visual calendar layout, is available on Pro and Business.

Play

Set up the integration

Select Platform:

  • Log in to Todoist at app.todoist.com
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select the Calendars tab.
  • Click Connect Google Calendar or Connect Outlook Calendar. If you’re using Outlook Calendar, check with your Microsoft admin if Todoist isn’t restricted in the Microsoft organization’s admin portals.
  • Check all 3 required permission boxes for the integration to work. Your Google or Outlook Calendar events will now appear in the Today and Upcoming views.

You can only connect to one calendar provider at a time. If you want to switch between calendar providers, you must first disconnect your calendar.

  • Open Todoist for iOS or Todoist for Android.
  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.
  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.
  • Select Calendar.
  • Tap Connect Google Calendar or Connect Outlook Calendar. If you’re using Outlook Calendar, check with your Microsoft admin if Todoist isn’t restricted in the Microsoft organization’s admin portals.
  • Check all 3 required permission boxes for the integration to work. Your Google or Outlook Calendar events will now appear in the Today and Upcoming views.

You can only connect to one calendar provider at a time. If you want to switch between calendar providers, you must first disconnect your calendar.

Note

Todoist requests the full scope of calendar permissions, so you can sync scheduled tasks as events. We neither store events in the Todoist databases nor access them in any way. We only store a reference of each calendar, so you can choose the calendars to view events from in Todoist.

View calendar events in Todoist

Calendar events appear only in the Today and Upcoming views. They don’t appear in the Inbox, which shows your tasks only.

Calendar events will look slightly different depending on what layout you set for your task list.

If you’re using either the list or board layouts, events are grouped in an event stack at the top of your task list.

If you’re using the calendar layout, your events will appear either in the All day section or as blocks of time, depending on what time and duration you’ve given them.

Note

Events for both today and future days are only visible to you and in Todoist. Event visibility and settings aren’t shared with anyone else in the project or team.

Access event details

Calendar events in Todoist are read-only, so they can’t be edited in the app. Instead, click the name of the event to open, view, or edit the event information in Google or Outlook Calendar.

Hide specific calendars

Todoist, by default, fetches events from every calendar in the connected Google or Outlook Calendar account. However, you can decide which calendars you want to see in Todoist:

Select Platform:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left of Todoist.
  • Select Settings.
  • Open the Calendars tab.
  • Click the visibility icon beside each calendar to show or hide it in Todoist.
  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.
  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.
  • Select Calendar.
  • Tap the visibility icon beside each calendar to show or hide it in Todoist.
  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.
  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.
  • Select Calendar.
  • Tap the visibility icon beside each calendar to show or hide it in Todoist. Note

With Outlook, calendars you don’t own are listed in the calendar list, but are hidden by default. Moreover, the integration won’t sync events for them. Click the visibility icon to see events from these calendars in Todoist.

Show events from multiple calendars

You can only connect one Google Calendar or Outlook calendar account at a time. However, you can view events from other calendars by subscribing to additional calendars with the Google or Outlook Calendar you’ve integrated with Todoist.

If you’ve integrated with Google Calendar:
  • Open your Google Calendar.
  • Click the plus icon next to Other calendars.
  • Depending on what kind of calendar you want to show events from, you have two options:
    • Subscribe to a calendar: Select this option to show events from another Google Calendar account.
    • From URL: Select this option to show events from another calendar provider like iCloud Calendar. Learn more in this Google help article.

For the integration to work, check that the calendars you’re subscribing to have See all event details sharing permissions selected for their account:

  • Hover your mouse over the calendar you are subscribing to in the left-hand menu of Google Calendar.
  • Click the three dots icon.
  • Select Settings.
  • Scroll down and find Permissions settings.
If you’ve integrated with Outlook Calendar:
  • Open your Outlook Calendar.
  • Click the Calendar icon in the sidebar.
  • Select Add calendar in the Calendar view.
  • Choose Subscribe from web.
  • Paste the URL of the calendar you wish to subscribe to into the provided field.
  • Give the calendar a name. You can also choose a color and icon.
  • Click Import to add the calendar to your Outlook Calendar. Learn more in this Microsoft article.

For the integration to work, check that the calendars you’re subscribing to have “can view all details” permissions selected for their account:

  • Open Outlook.com.

  • Click the Calendar icon in the sidebar.

  • Right-click the subscribed calendar in the left panel.

  • Select Sharing and permissions. You will see a list of users with permissions. Your name should be listed with a permission level, such as:

  • Can view when I’m busy (limited view)

  • Can view all details (read-only access)

  • Can edit (allows modifications)

  • Delegate (full control, including responding to invites)

Hide calendar events in Todoist

If you want to hide calendar events in Todoist:

Select Platform:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.

  • Select Settings.

  • Click the Calendars tab.

  • Turn off Show events in Todoist. After turning this option off, calendar events are automatically hidden in the Today and Upcoming views.

  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.

  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.

  • Select Calendar.

  • Turn off Show events in Todoist. After turning this option off, calendar events are automatically hidden in the Today and Upcoming views.

  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.

  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.

  • Select Calendar.

  • Turn off Show events in Todoist. After turning this option off, calendar events are automatically hidden in the Today and Upcoming views.

Hide Google Calendar Birthday events

Google stores Birthday events as part of your primary Google calendar, so there’s no separate Birthday calendar to hide in Todoist.

To stop seeing Birthday events in Todoist, open your Calendars tab and hide your primary Google calendar. If you don’t want to see Birthday events, but you need to display your primary Google calendar in Todoist, follow these steps:

  • Open Google Calendar.
  • Click Settings > Other calendars > Birthdays.
  • Turn off Sync from Contacts.
  • Switch back to Todoist.
  • Open the Calendars tab.
  • Click Resync.

Sync scheduled Todoist tasks

With the Calendar integration, you can sync your scheduled tasks assigned to you to Google or Outlook Calendar. This lets you mirror your Todoist schedule to your calendar, and makes it easier to find available time for new events or meeting invites.

To get started, turn the Sync tasks to calendar option on:

Select Platform:

  • Log in to the Todoist web app or any of the desktop apps.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click the Calendars tab. You’ll see the following options:
    • Sync tasks to calendar: Toggle on to have time-blocked tasks appear as events in a new calendar named Todoist.
    • Sync all-day tasks: Toggle on to also see tasks with only a date on your calendar. Note

If you’re using Outlook Calendar, click Show all to see the Todoist calendar. Then, click the checkbox to make it visible.

If you don’t want to sync your tasks to your calendar, leave this option off.

  • Open Todoist on your mobile device.
  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.
  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.
  • Tap Calendar. You’ll see the following options:
    • Sync tasks to calendar: toggle on to have time-blocked tasks appear as events in a new calendar named Todoist.
    • Sync all-day tasks: toggle on to also see tasks with only a date on your calendar. Note

If you’re using Outlook Calendar, tap Show all to see the Todoist calendar. Then, tap the checkbox to make it visible.

If you don’t want to sync your tasks to your calendar, leave this option off.

Warning

All events added to the Todoist calendar will be deleted if you turn off Sync tasks to calendar in the Calendar settings. This includes any event you manually added to that calendar.

Your synced information

After setting up the integration, the initial sync will display tasks from yesterday, due today, and those scheduled for the future. As you use the integration, you’ll see specific information synced between Todoist tasks and their equivalent calendar events:

If in Todoist, you

update the task’s date

the event’s start and end dates are updated

the event’s name remains as it is and it stays on the calendar

the event’s name is updated with a checkmark ✔️ and it stays on the calendar

Note: when a recurring task is completed forever the remaining recurring events will be removed from the calendar
