Get started with Todoist Business

When your team’s work lives in one place, collaboration becomes effortless. Todoist’s Business plan gives your team a dedicated workspace to organize shared projects, track progress, and stay aligned, all while keeping personal work private and separate.

Play

This guide explains how the Business plan transforms the simplicity you love about Todoist into a powerful hub for team collaboration, with features designed specifically to help teams work better together.

Quick tip

Ready to roll out Todoist to your team? The Set Up Your Team Workspace course in the Todoist Toolkit takes about 15 minutes and helps you build a workspace your team will feel comfortable in.

Work better together

The Business plan is designed for teams that need a dedicated workspace to collaborate, organize shared projects, and keep everyone aligned. Here’s what makes it powerful:

  • Team Workspace: Create a shared workspace where your team can collaborate. An account can have a maximum of 500 projects. Everyone gets access to the projects they need, while personal projects (located in My Projects) stay completely private and separate.
  • Increased Members and Guests: Invite up to 1,000 team members (including guests) to collaborate on specific projects without giving them access to your entire workspace.
  • Folders: Organize project folders to keep your team’s work structured and easy to navigate, no matter how complex your projects get.
  • Browse and Join Projects: Admins and members can browse all team projects, preview their contents, and join any project that’s relevant to their work with no direct invitation needed. This makes it easy for teams to discover and access the projects they need without waiting for someone to add them manually. Note

When you upgrade to the Business plan, all team members automatically get access to all Pro features in their personal projects. After all, when your teammates are on top of their personal to-dos, teamwork tends to flow more smoothly too. Learn more about teams in Todoist.

Key Business features

The Todoist Business plan unlocks features that help your team stay aligned, productive, and in control of shared work.

Clarity and visibility across projects
  • Calendar layout and Board layout: See team work visually with boards that track task progress and workflow stages at a glance.
  • Project Insights: Get data-driven insights into your team’s productivity with metrics that show task completion trends, project progress, and team performance over time.
Stay in sync with your team
  • Team Filters: Create custom filters to see exactly what your team is working on, what’s overdue, or what’s assigned to specific team members. Filter by workspace, assignee, or project to get the view you need.
  • People Tab: See your team’s full workload at a glance. View each team member’s assigned and overdue tasks across all team projects, click into the details by project, and quickly spot where someone might need support.
  • Direct Project Links: Share direct links to projects, sections, tasks, and comments that teammates can preview and instantly take action on, making collaboration faster and more efficient.
Organize and control team work
  • Team Roles and Permissions: Assign roles (Admin, Member, or Guest) to control who can access and manage team projects, giving you the right level of control and security for your workspace.
  • Restricted Projects: Control access to sensitive projects by making them restricted. Only invited members can see and access these projects, keeping confidential work secure within your team workspace.
  • Shared Templates: Create and share project templates across your team to standardize workflows, ensure consistency, and help everyone get started quickly on new projects.
  • Centralized Billing: Manage your entire team’s subscription from one place with consolidated billing, making it easy to add or remove members and keep track of costs. Pierre · Security Specialist

Learn more about the security options for your Todoist team.

Separate work and life
  • Focused views: You cangroup or filter your tasks by personal and team projects to better separate work and life. You decide what you see and when.
  • Private Personal Projects: Your personal projects in My Projects stay completely private and in your full control, even when you’re collaborating with a team in a shared workspace.

Get started with Todoist Pro

Thinking about going Pro? This guide walks through the features and higher limits you get on the Todoist Pro plan: task durations, custom reminders, the calendar layout, all without losing the simplicity you came for.

Play

Get more done

If you’re organizing more of your life in Todoist, Pro raises the limits that were starting to feel tight:

  • Active Projects: Jump from 5 active projects on Beginner to 300 on Pro. That’s room to keep work, family, and personal goals in separate projects instead of cramming them together.
  • Filter Views: Go from 3 filter views to 150. Filters are a powerful way to organize and visualize tasks across all your projects and workspaces, helping you see exactly what you need, when you need it. Note

For a full breakdown of the limits on each plan, see usage limits in Todoist.

Key Pro features

Here’s what Pro adds, grouped by what it helps you actually do.

Clarity and confidence in your plan

Play

  • Calendar Layout: Visualize your tasks in a calendar layout to easily build a realistic daily plan. This makes it simple to spot if you’ve overloaded your schedule, or where you have open time to get things done.
  • Task Durations: Add an estimated time for how long a task will take, which helps you keep your plans realistic and is a great tool for time-blocking.
Track your progress
  • Project Insights: See how your projects are progressing without manual tracking or check-ins. Insights automatically surfaces how your work is moving based on what you actually do, with no extra setup needed. You’ll see at-risk tasks, progress, and recently completed work across your projects, with an overview of all your projects under My Projects.
Reminders

Play

  • Time-Based Reminders: Easily set reminders for tasks at specific times, receiving alerts via email, desktop, or mobile notification. You can use natural language expressions like “tomorrow at 8:00 a.m.” to automatically set a reminder minutes before the due time. You can easily change how far in advance the reminder will be displayed in your Settings.
  • Location Reminders: Use your mobile device’s location services to set reminders for when you arrive at or leave a certain location. Need to chat to your son’s teacher about something? Set a reminder for when you arrive at the school.
  • Recurring Reminders: You can even pair automatic reminders with recurring tasks such as “daily journalling”, so you’re reminded on time, every time.
Work smarter with AI

Play

  • Ramble: A voice-to-tasks feature that lets you add tasks using your voice. Ramble listens, transcribes, and captures actionable tasks in real-time. Pro gives you unlimited Ramble sessions, so you can always think out loud without hitting a limit.
  • Task Assist: An extension with several options to quickly enhance your workflows. Use it to get task suggestions, make tasks more actionable, get tips for completing a task, or break a task down into sub-tasks.
Peace of mind
  • Daily Automatic Backups: You have access to daily automated backups, so you can quickly restore a previous version of your project if you accidentally delete a task or project.
  • Themes: Unlock a variety of themes to personalize the color and overall look of your app, making your space for productivity feel a little bit more like you.

Legacy Todoist for Business

Note

As of December 10, 2025, the Legacy Business plan is no longer available. Existing subscribers can continue using their plan until it expires.

We understand that hearing about an update to your subscription, especially regarding pricing, is never easy. We want to be completely open about why we’re retiring the legacy Todoist for Business plan and moving all remaining legacy subscriptions onto our current Business plan.

The price is changing because the product has evolved. The current Business plan is built on the Team Workspace, a completely new and more powerful Todoist that delivers significantly more value for team collaboration than the old plan.

Then vs. Now: the value of the new Business plan

The legacy pricing structure no longer supports the extensive value delivered by today’s Business plan and Team Workspace, which replaced the former “Todoist for Business” product in January 2024.

Since the launch of Team Workspaces, legacy “Todoist for Business” subscribers have been able to use all new features and product updates while still on the original legacy pricing. The current price reflects this added functionality and our commitment to building products that serve your team for decades to come.

Here is a side-by-side look at the features and focus of the two plans:

Feature/Focus

Legacy Todoist for Business (Before)

Current Business Plan (Now)

Workspace Model

Individual account management with shared projects

Team Workspace for seamless organization and collaboration

Team Oversight

Limited visibility via Reporting

Comprehensive Team Insights for full transparency into progress

Planning Tools

Primarily List layout

Visual Calendar Layoutsfor realistic planning and a birds-eye view

Task Sorting

Standard sorting options

Advanced sorting plus Team Filters (coming soon)

Team discovery

All members needed to be invited one by one

The corporate email domain allows automatic joining of a Todoist team

Browsable projects

Members need to be invited to each project

Browse and preview public team projects and join only the relevant ones

Multi-team Support

One team per Todoist account

Multiple teams with different roles in one Todoist account

The current plan gives you powerful tools like Team Workspaces, visual Calendar Layouts, and Team Insights for better organization, effective planning, and clear progress tracking.

Subscription status and new plan transition

The legacy Todoist for Business plan has been formally retired and is no longer available. All customers previously on this plan are automatically transitioned to the current Business plan, which is built around the Team Workspace. This aligns all subscriptions with the latest feature set and current pricing structure.

Note

For details on your specific pricing and renewal date, please refer to the latest communication sent to your email.

FAQ

Changes to your team size are handled as follows:

  • Members added before December 10, 2025: You will be charged for these new members at your legacy rate.
  • Members added on or after December 10, 2025: These members will be charged at the new rate. This charge will be prorated based on the date new members were added. For teams on an annual subscription, prorated charges for new members added mid-year are invoiced pro rata in the following month. Your yearly renewal invoice will reflect the new annual rate for all members active on that date.

The Business plan is purposely built for robust team collaboration. If you are the sole member of your team workspace, you may find that the individual Pro plan is a better fit for your needs.

Follow these steps to cancel your Business plan and upgrade your account to the Pro plan.

Manage your Todoist Business subscription

Team admins can either update billing information, download invoices, or downgrade the Todoist Business subscription.

Note

Team billing settings are only accessible from the Todoist web app. To manage your Business subscription or download invoices, log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com.

If you’re an admin who needs to make these changes, here are the steps:

Access team billing settings

  • Log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click your team name in the sidebar.
  • Click Settings at the top-right.
  • Click Subscription under your team’s name in the left-hand sidebar.
  • Click Manage team billing.

Make changes to the subscription

In the team billing settings, you have several options:

  • Review when your Business subscription will end, and how much your renewal’s going to be.
  • Click Add payment method to add a new payment method. Here’s a list of supported payment methods.
  • Click Update information to update your billing name, address or to change your Business subscription billing cycle. Warning

If your Business subscription ends and there’s no active payment method, the plan will cancel and revert to the Beginner plan. Your data is secured, but you’ll lose access to Business features.

Change billing currency

If you need to change the billing currency, you’ll want to first cancel your Todoist Business subscription. Then, start a new one and select your preferred currency.

Change the billing email address

The first payment receipt for the Business plan is sent exclusively to the admin who upgraded the team. It’s not possible to add other email addresses as billing recipients. If the person who upgraded the team is no longer with the team, get in touch with us. We’ll assign a new team admin.

Note

Only your first payment triggers a confirmation email. Renewals are not emailed. You can download invoices directly from your billing settings.

Download your invoice

  • Log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click your team name in the sidebar.
  • Click Settings at the top-right.
  • Click Subscription under your team’s name in the left-hand sidebar.
  • Click Manage team billing.
  • Click the invoice you need below the Invoice History section to download a copy. Note

If you upgraded to Todoist Business before March 2022, you can access any invoice created before this date right in the Subscription settings.

Change your Business subscription billing cycle

Todoist Business is available as a monthly or yearly subscription. You can change your billing cycle at any time:

  • Log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click your team name in the sidebar.
  • Click Settings at the top-right.
  • Click Subscription under your team’s name in the left-hand sidebar.
  • Click Manage team billing.
  • Click Update subscription.
  • Select either the Monthly or Yearly tab.
  • Click Continue to confirm.

Update past invoices

If you’ve changed your billing address or VAT ID, you won’t be able to retroactively edit and apply these changes to past invoices. If you need an updated invoice, get in touch with us.

Transfer credit from the subscription

If you’ve received credit for the remaining time of your Business subscription, this isn’t transferrable to another team or plan. You can, however, request a refund if you were charged for the subscription in the last 30 days.

Cancel your subscription

If you’re the admin of a Todoist team, and you no longer need the Business plan, here’s how to cancel your Business subscription:

  • Click your team in the sidebar.
  • Click Subscription under the team name.
  • Click Cancel plan. You’ll see a list of benefits you’ll miss after canceling your subscription.
  • Click Cancel subscription.
  • Select the reason for the cancellation. Provide any feedback you may have about the plan.
  • Click Cancel subscription. You’ll see your plan type, price, and the end of the billing period.
  • Click Cancel subscription to review your subscription details.
  • Click Cancel subscription again to confirm. Note

If you’ve canceled your Business subscription within 30 days of purchase, get in touch with us to receive a refund.

FAQ

Can I stop a failed payment from being retried?

Failed payments are automatically retried for a period of time. During this period, your Business subscription will remain active. If the payment remains unresolved after multiple retry attempts, your subscription will be canceled.

If you would like to stop further payment attempts, please contact support for assistance.

  • Select Settings.
  • Open the Subscription tab.
  • Click Go to billing. You’ll see your billing information on a new page.
  • Click Add payment method.
  • Enter your new payment card details.
  • Click Add to confirm. If you’d like to set the new payment card as the default, click the three dots icon beside it and select Make default.

If you want to delete any older cards, make sure you have an active payment card first. Then, click the three dots icon beside the older card, and choose Delete.

To update your card details for the App Store, you can follow Apple’s instructions.

To update your card details for Google Play, you can follow Google’s instructions.

Change billing currency

If you need to change the billing currency, you’ll want to first cancel your Todoist Pro subscription. Then, start a new one and select your preferred currency.

If you purchased your subscription with an in-app purchase with Apple, and you’d like to pay for Pro in a different currency, follow these instructions to change your region.

If you purchased your subscription with an in-app purchase with Google Play, and you’d like to pay for Pro in a different currency, follow these instructions to change your region.

Change your billing cycle

Todoist Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription. You can change your billing cycle at any time:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Click Settings.
  • Open the Subscription tab.
  • Click Go to billing.
  • Click Update subscription on the right.
  • Select either the Monthly or Yearly tab. You’ll see your updated subscription price.
  • Click Continue to confirm. To change your subscription plan via the App Store, whether from monthly to yearly and vice versa, follow these instructions. The change will only be applied when the current cycle ends.

Let’s say you have a yearly subscription and you change your billing to monthly while you still have 6 months left on your subscription, you’ll keep the yearly subscription until it expires. Once your subscription runs out, the new monthly billing cycle will begin.

To change your subscription plan via Google Play, whether from monthly to yearly and vice versa, follow these instructions. Based on the subscription, you may have to pay the full price or the price difference of the new plan.

Change your billing email address

Keep your billing email address up to date so we can reach you about your subscription.

If you need to change your billing email address, get in touch with us. We’ll update your billing email address manually for you. The update will apply to future invoices when you download them.

If you purchased your subscription with an in-app purchase with Apple, and you need to change the billing email address, add the new email or change your existing email to your Apple Account.

If you purchased your subscription with an in-app purchase with Google Play, and you need to change the billing email address, follow these instructions.

Download your invoice

Need a copy of your invoice? Here’s where to find your invoice history and download what you need.

Only your first payment triggers a confirmation email. We don’t email an invoice for each payment.

  • Click your avatar in the top-left.
  • Click Settings.
  • Open the Subscription tab.
  • Click Go to billing. You’ll see your billing information on a new page.
  • Scroll to the INVOICE HISTORY section.
  • Click the invoice to download a copy. Invoices can only be downloaded from the Todoist website or desktop app. This feature is not available on mobile devices.

To see and download a copy of your receipt for Todoist Pro, follow these instructions to view your purchase history from your selected device.

To see and download a copy of your receipt for Todoist Pro, follow these instructions to find and download your Google Play store receipt.

Update past invoices

If you’ve changed your billing address or VAT ID, you won’t be able to retroactively edit and apply these changes to past invoices. If you need all your invoices to include your new information, get in touch with us. We’ll update them for you.

Note

If you’ve purchased Pro via direct billing, and you have a VAT ID, you can receive a VAT refund and a reverse-charge refund notice. Make sure to add your VAT ID and the associated address to your Pro billing information, and get in touch with your request.

About price adjustments in your invoice

You may notice a different amount in your invoice when compared to the price of your plan. This can happen when a change was made to your subscription between invoices.

Here are a few scenarios:

  • You changed your billing cycle from monthly to yearly, or from yearly to monthly.
  • You upgraded from Pro to Business mid-cycle. Any unused Pro time is credited to your account and can be used for future Pro payments only. It isn’t applied to your Business subscription or transferred between team workspaces.
  • We may have given you a discount or added credit to your account. In all of these cases, we prorated and adjusted the amount due, which explains why there can be a discrepancy between the amount on your invoice and the actual price of your plan.

Note

If the amount on your bank statement is higher than the price on your Todoist invoice, the difference is from your bank, not Todoist. Currency conversion or international transaction fees go directly to your bank and don’t appear on Todoist invoices. For details on how VAT applies to your plan, see VAT-exempt invoices and payments for Todoist.

Cancel your subscription

If you no longer wish to continue using Todoist Pro, here’s how to cancel your subscription based on your payment method:

  • Log in to your Todoist account on todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select the Subscription tab.
  • Click Cancel plan. You’ll see a list of benefits you’ll miss after canceling your subscription.
  • Click Cancel subscription.
  • Select the reason for the cancellation. Provide any feedback you may have about the plan.
  • Click Cancel subscription to confirm. If you purchased your subscription with an in-app purchase with Apple, it’s managed through the App Store. Follow these instructions to cancel your subscription before it renews.

If you purchased your subscription with an in-app purchase with Google, it’s managed through the Google Play store. Follow these instructions to cancel your subscription before it renews.

After canceling your subscription, you’ll still have access to Pro features until it expires. You’ll then revert back to the Free plan.

If you’ve canceled your Pro subscription within 30 days of purchase or renewal, you’re eligible for a full refund.

FAQ

Can I stop a failed payment from being retried?

Failed payments are automatically retried for a period of time. During this period, your Pro subscription will remain active. If the payment remains unresolved after multiple retry attempts, your subscription will be canceled.

If you would like to stop further payment attempts, please contact support for assistance.

Supported payment methods

  • China UnionPay (CUP)

  • eftpos Australia
  • Japan Credit Bureau (JCB)

Upgrade a team to Business

Warning

If you’re using Todoist for iOS or Todoist for Android, switch to the Todoist web app to upgrade or downgrade a team.

When you upgrade a team to the Business plan, each team member will automatically have access to Pro features in their personal projects. Here’s how to upgrade a team:

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Find your Todoist team name.
  • Select Subscription tab to upgrade the plan.
  • Click Start for free. Receipts aren’t automatically sent to the team admin when the payment is successful. Access receipts at any time through the team billing settings.
For existing Pro customers

Quick tip

While you can create a single-person team and upgrade to Business, we believe you’ll get the best value from Todoist Pro. Compare the two plans on our Pricing page.

When you upgrade to Todoist Business within 30 days of purchasing Todoist Pro, you’re eligible for a full refund.

When you upgrade to Todoist Business, beyond the 30-day refund period, any remaining time on your Pro subscription is converted into credit in our system, regardless of whether you purchased Todoist Pro through direct billing (Stripe), the App Store, or Google Play. This credit can only be used to pay for future Todoist Pro subscriptions via our website; it can’t be used for your Business subscription.

If you’d prefer a partial refund instead of credit, the available option depends on how you originally paid for Todoist Pro:

  • For payments made through direct billing (Stripe) or Google Play, you can request a partial refund for the remaining time on your Pro subscription.
  • For payments made through the App Store, where we can’t issue a refund, we transfer the remaining time to your account as credit instead. Note

If you purchased Todoist Pro through the App Store or Google Play, make sure to cancel your subscription to prevent the auto-renewal.

Add people to the team

Team admins can manage team billing, and add members or guests to the team between billing cycles. Your team will be billed based on the number of members in the billing cycle, and all members will be billed on a single invoice. Guests are free of charge and won’t appear on the invoice.

Here’s how this will be handled in the invoice:

Monthly billing

If you’re on monthly billing, and you’re adding new members to your team in the middle of the cycle, your next monthly invoice will include their subscription for the month ahead and the charges based on the time they belonged to the team during the previous month.

Here’s an example:

Your monthly subscription starts on January 1, 2024. You’ve added Caroline to your team on January 14th.

On February 1st, you’ll be charged for the month ahead for you and Caroline, and for Caroline’s time on the team from January 14th until January 31st.

Yearly billing

If you’re on yearly billing, and you’re adding new members to your team in the middle of the cycle, you’ll receive an invoice during the following month based on your original purchase date. Your invoice will include the amount due for each new member for the remainder of their yearly subscription, as well as charges based on the amount of time they belonged to the team during the previous yearly billing period.

Here’s an example:

Your yearly subscription started on January 1, 2024. You’ve added Diane to your team on February 20th.

On March 1st, you’ll be charged for Diane’s subscription from February 20th to January 1st, 2025.

Remove people from the team

Team admins alone can manage team billing, and remove people from the team between billing cycles.

If you remove one of your team members, you’ll only be charged for the time they belonged to the team. The equivalent of the time the removed member was no longer part of the team will be credited back to you and will be immediately deducted from the amount due on your next monthly or yearly invoice.

Set up a Todoist Pro subscription

There are three different platforms you can use to set up a Todoist Pro subscription:

A paid plan is associated with the Todoist account, not to a specific device. When you upgrade, you have access to paid features on any of your devices so long as you’re logged in to the same Todoist account.

Subscribe through the Todoist website

If you’d like to upgrade to a monthly or yearly Pro subscription through the Todoist website:

Select Platform:

  • Open Todoist in a browser via todoist.com.

  • Click Settings.
  • Open the Subscription tab.
  • Click Upgrade to Pro.
  • Select whether you want to pay yearly or monthly and select the currency you wish to pay with.
  • Click Continue to checkout.
  • On the checkout page, enter your payment details. Optional: If you’d like to save your payment details with Link to re-use them in the future, select the checkbox Securely save the information for 1-click checkout.
  • Click Subscribe to upgrade to Pro. Note

If you choose to pay monthly, Pro costs $7 per month. If you choose to pay yearly, Pro costs $60 per year ($5 per month billed yearly), which saves you about 30%. Learn more about the 2025 pricing update.

Refresh your App Store subscription in Todoist

If you’ve purchased or renewed Todoist Pro through the App Store but your account is still showing as the Beginner plan and Pro features aren’t available, Todoist may not have recognized your App Store subscription yet. Refreshing your subscription syncs your App Store subscription with your Todoist account. Here’s how:

Select Platform:

If you’ve purchased a Todoist subscription through the Mac App Store:

  • Open Todoist for macOS.

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.

  • Select Upgrade to Pro.

  • Click Refresh subscription at the bottom of the pop-up. If you’ve purchased a Todoist subscription through the App Store:

  • Open Todoist for iOS.

  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.

  • Tap the gear icon at the top-right.

  • Select Todoist Pro.

  • Tap Refresh subscription below the Subscribe Now button. Carol · Customer Experience Specialist

The Refresh subscription option only works on the platform you’ve used to purchase the Todoist subscription. For example, you can only activate your Mac App Store purchase while using Todoist for macOS. At the moment, this option is only supported on the App Store (iOS/macOS) and is not available on Android devices.

Subscribe through Google Play

If you’d like to upgrade to a monthly or yearly Pro plan subscription through Google Play:

Select Platform:

  • Tap the gear icon in the top-right.
  • Tap Upgrade to Pro.

  • Tap Subscribe. Uninstalling the Todoist app does not automatically cancel your Pro plan subscription. If you decide to downgrade to the Beginner plan, cancel your Pro plan subscription in Google Play.

Troubleshoot issues with your Pro plan

If your Pro plan isn’t applied to your Todoist account yet, follow these steps to troubleshoot the issue:

  • Check your Todoist account details, like your email address or login method. See if they match the account details associated with your Pro plan.
  • Verify the email address in the account settings.
  • Get in touch with us if you’re still having issues with your Pro plan.
Subscribed through the App Store?

If so, you may need to share your Order ID with us to resolve a billing or subscription issue. Here’s how to find it on your iPhone or iPad:

  • Open the App Store app.
  • Tap your profile icon (or Sign In) at the top of the screen.
  • Tap Purchase History. You may be asked to sign in.
  • Tap the date range at the top (it defaults to Last 90 Days) and choose a wider range, like the full year, if you don’t see your purchase.
  • Find Todoist in the list and tap it to open the details.
  • Share the Order ID shown on this screen with us. A screenshot works too. The Order ID looks something like MMQD6KY5H9. Note

App Store subscriptions are tied to the Apple ID used to purchase them, not to your Todoist account. If you share an Apple ID with family members, the subscription applies to whichever Todoist account is logged in on that device. To avoid this, you can subscribe directly at todoist.com or use separate Apple IDs.

Todoist Business Plan: Pricing Update

We understand that pricing is an important consideration for your team. To be transparent, we want to let you know that we’re updating the price of the Todoist Business plan.

The price update will directly support our continued investment in the powerful team features you rely on, as well as the development of new ones to help your team collaborate and stay productive.

Starting December 10, 2025, the Todoist Business plan will cost:

Billing cycle

Old price

New price

Monthly

$8 USD per user/month

$10 USD per user/month

Yearly

$6 USD per user/month ($72 per user/year)

$8 USD per user/month ($96 per user/per year)

This new pricing takes effect on your next renewal date on or after December 10, 2025. You can find your specific renewal date in your team’s Subscription settings.

What’s changing and why

We’re committed to delivering lasting value. Over the past few years, we’ve introduced foundational features to the Business plan, such as:

  • Team workspaces for clearer structure and collaboration.
  • Calendar layouts for planning team work, plus board layouts for visualizing team projects. Board layout available on all plans.
  • Team insights for better visibility into progress. Our commitment to teamwork continues. Coming soon, you can expect new functionality designed to make your teamwork more transparent and efficient, such as team filters for quickly sorting team tasks and Project Insights for a clearer view of project progress.

This price update will directly support our continued investment in the powerful features and reliability your team counts on. Moreover, updating our pricing allows us to keep improving Todoist and ensure it remains a reliable, secure, and productive platform for your team.

When this change takes effect

The new pricing will apply automatically on your next renewal date on or after December 10, 2025.

  • If your team is on a monthly plan, you’ll see the new rate on your first invoice on or after this date.
  • If your team is on a yearly plan, your subscription will renew at the new price at the end of your current billing cycle (if it ends on or after this date). You can find your specific renewal date in your team’s Subscription settings.

FAQ

Yes, the new price will automatically apply to your next renewal on or after December 10, 2025. No action is needed on your part unless you wish to change your plan or billing cycle.

Changes to your team size are handled as follows:

  • Members added before December 10, 2025: If you add new members before this date, you’ll be charged for them at your current (old) rate.
  • Members added on or after December 10, 2025: If you add a new member on or after this date, they will be charged at the new rate ($10 USD/month or $8 USD/user/year). This charge will be prorated. When you add new members mid-cycle while on the yearly plan, you’ll receive a prorated invoice on the purchase date of the following month. This single invoice will include the amount due for each new member for the remainder of your yearly subscription.

Here’s an example:

  • Your yearly subscription started on November 15, 2025 (Original purchase date is the 15th)
  • You add a new member on January 20, 2026.
  • On February 15, 2026, you will receive one prorated invoice for that new member. The invoice will cover the period from January 20, 2026 (the date they were added) until November 15, 2026 (the end of your yearly cycle).
  • When your plan renews on November 15, 2026, your renewal invoice will include all current members at the applicable rate for the next year. On your main renewal date, your invoice will reflect the new, total number of members for the full upcoming year.

The Pro plan is designed for individuals so it’s not possible to move your team to the Pro plan.

However, if you are the only member in the workspace and want to move your own individual account to the Pro plan, you can do so by following the steps to cancel your Business plan before changing subscription to the Pro plan.

Pricing and billing FAQ

How much does Todoist Pro cost?
  • $7/month, or
  • $60/year ($5/month billed yearly) Pricing in other currencies is listed in Todoist Pro pricing update in 2025.
How much does Todoist Business cost?
  • $10/user/month, or
  • $8/user/month billed yearly ($96/user/year) Pricing in other currencies is listed in Business plan pricing update.
What payment methods do you accept?

Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and more), App Store, Google Play, SEPA (Europe, by request), and others. For the full list, see Supported payment methods and currencies.

Can I share my Pro features with my family or another person?

No. Each Pro subscription is tied to one Todoist account. Family Sharing (Apple) and Family Library (Google Play) aren’t supported for Todoist Pro. If you collaborate with someone in a shared project, they need their own subscription to use Pro features.

Can I get a refund?

Yearly plans are refundable within 30 days of purchase or renewal. On Pro, you can request the refund yourself from your subscription settings. On Business, cancel your team first, then get in touch with us to request it. Monthly subscriptions aren’t refundable. See Request a refund for the full policy and how to request one.

What is the Pro Legacy plan?

Only a limited number of users are eligible for the Pro Legacy plan. For specific information on what features are included, see Todoist Pro Legacy plan.

Switching plans

How do I upgrade to a paid plan?
  • To Pro: see Set up a Todoist Pro subscription
  • To Business: see Set up a Todoist Business subscription
Can I switch from Pro to Business?

Yes. If you upgrade from Pro to Business within 30 days of starting Pro, you’re eligible for a refund of your Pro payment. After 30 days, any remaining Pro time is converted into account credit for future Pro renewals.

Can I move from Business back to Pro or Beginner?

Yes. See Move from Business to Pro or Beginner for the steps.

How do I cancel?

See Cancel a Todoist subscription. You can cancel anytime and keep using your paid features until your current billing period ends.

What happens to my data if I downgrade?

You don‘t lose any data. Projects above the new plan’s limit become view-only until you either upgrade again or archive or delete some. See What happens when I downgrade my plan? for the full breakdown.

Todoist Pro Legacy plan

The Pro Legacy plan lets eligible long-term subscribers keep paying for Todoist Pro at the price they had before June 2022. It dates back to Todoist’s June 6, 2022 pricing change and continues after the December 10, 2025 pricing update. Below, you’ll find who’s eligible, how the plans compare, and how to manage your subscription.

Understand the Pro Legacy plan

The Todoist Pro Legacy plan allows eligible long-term subscribers to continue using Todoist Pro at the specific price they were paying before June 2022. Users subscribed via the App Store also remain on their current price by default.

The existing features will continue to be supported and available. However, new paid features released after December 10, 2025 won’t be incorporated into the Pro Legacy plan. This includes Todoist Assist and Email Assist.

Check your eligibility

You’re on the Pro Legacy plan if:

  • You subscribed to the Pro plan before June 2022, have maintained your subscription continuously under the conditions outlined previously (for example, haven’t changed plan type or certain billing cycles), and received an email confirming your continuation on the “Pro Legacy plan”.
  • You subscribed to the Pro plan via the App Store before December 10, 2025, regardless of your original subscription date or price. Due to App Store policies, these subscriptions do not automatically increase in price and remain on the legacy feature set unless manually upgraded.

Note

Want to switch to the Pro plan right away, before your current billing cycle ends? If you’ve already canceled your Pro Legacy subscription, or you don’t see an upgrade option in the app, get in touch with us and we’ll help you switch.

How do I upgrade from Pro Legacy to the new Pro plan?

If you subscribe through the Todoist website or the Google Play Store, follow the steps below to switch to the new Pro plan. If you subscribe through the App Store, you’ll manage the change in your App Store account.

  • Billed by Todoist: Go to your Subscription tab in settings and select the option to upgrade.

  • Billed by the App Store: Manage your subscription and upgrade through your App Store account settings. If you’re billed by Google Play:

  • Open the Todoist app on your Android device.

  • Tap Browse.

  • Tap the gear icon in the top-left corner.

  • Tap Pro Legacy and follow the upgrade process. Note

Make sure to upgrade via the same App Store where you purchased your legacy subscription. If you need help, get in touch with us.

What happens when I upgrade from Pro Legacy to the Pro plan?

Billing platform

What happens

Google Play & Stripe (direct billing)

  • Your renewal date stays the same.

  • You’ll be charged a prorated amount for the remainder of your current billing cycle.

  • The prorated rate is calculated based on what you’ve already paid for your legacy plan renewal and the remaining time on your subscription at the new Pro plan price. App Store

  • Your Pro Legacy plan will be canceled and you’ll receive a partial refund for the remaining time.

  • You’ll then be charged the full price for the Pro plan (with all features unlocked).

  • The refund may take 24-48 hours to process. Warning

Once you upgrade from the Pro Legacy plan to the Pro plan, you cannot switch back to the Pro Legacy pricing.

Get answers to common questions

Can I start a free trial to try the new Pro plan?

No. Free trials aren’t available while you have an active Pro Legacy subscription, since you’re already on a paid Pro plan. To use the latest Pro features, upgrade to the Pro plan. If you’d like to switch immediately, before your current billing cycle ends, get in touch with us.

Will the Pro Legacy plan receive any new updates or features?

Pro Legacy will continue to receive essential updates that keep Todoist stable, secure, and compatible with new platforms.

It will also continue to benefit from improvements that affect the core Todoist experience and apply across all plans. These include any features we release to the Beginner plan and updates that keep the app consistent and reliable for everyone, such as enhancements to interface, usability, accessibility, or overall performance.

Do I keep my Pro Legacy plan pricing?

Yes. You’ll keep your Pro Legacy pricing as long as your subscription remains active and unchanged.

Similar to our previous legacy conditions, your special pricing will only be removed if you:

  • Change your subscription type (e.g. upgrade to the Business plan) or change your billing cycle (e.g. from annual to monthly and vice versa).
  • Cancel your subscription.
  • Receive a refund for your subscription.
  • Change your billing provider (e.g. move from direct billing to the App Store).
How can I check if I am on a Pro Legacy plan?

You can find your current plan details in your account settings. Here’s how:

  • Click your avatar in the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click the Subscription tab.
Will the Pro Legacy plan receive bug fixes and security updates?

Yes, absolutely. We’re committed to ensuring Todoist remains reliable and secure for everyone. While the Pro Legacy plan won’t receive new paid features released after December 10, 2025, the existing features included in your plan will continue to be fully supported and maintained, receiving necessary bug fixes and security updates.

Will the Pro Legacy plan ever be discontinued entirely?

We are committed to fully supporting and maintaining the existing features included in the Pro Legacy plan (those available up to December 10, 2025) for users who remain on it. We have no plans to discontinue the Pro Legacy plan. Our focus is on ensuring the features you rely on continue to work reliably.

Note

You can find our full Terms of Service on our website. All details regarding payments, subscriptions, and renewals are covered in Section 4: General Payment Terms.

Todoist Pro pricing update in 2025

Todoist updated the Pro plan price on December 10, 2025, to support long-term product sustainability and the development of advanced productivity features. This article explains our approach to these adjustments, our commitment to staying independent, and how we prioritize providing value to our global community of users.

Pro plan pricing overview

Starting December 10, 2025, the Todoist Pro plan costs:

Billing cycle

Old price

New price

Monthly

$5 USD per month

$7 USD per month

Yearly

$4 USD per month ($48 per year)

$5 USD per month ($60 per year)

Why the price changed

Investing in Todoist allows us to continuously improve the product and develop new, powerful features. Over the past few years, we’ve focused on adding new ways to help you plan and prioritize, such as:

  • Calendar layouts to plan tasks over time.
  • Deadlines to keep track of key dates so nothing slips through the cracks. We’re also working on features such as Ramble, which lets you capture tasks using your voice, and continuing to explore new ways to help automate your daily work.

This price update helps us keep investing in Todoist sustainably while delivering a reliable and secure experience.

When the new pricing takes effect

The new pricing will apply automatically on your next renewal date on or after December 10, 2025.

  • If you’re billed monthly, you’ll see the new rate on your first invoice on or after this date.
  • If you’re billed yearly, you’ll renew at the updated price by the end of your billing cycle on or after this date. You can find your renewal date in your Subscription settings.

Sync & Integrations

Troubleshoot Google Calendar integration issues in Todoist

Are your tasks not syncing to Google Calendar, or are calendar events not appearing in Todoist? When the Google Calendar integration isn’t working as intended, it can disrupt your productivity workflow. Follow these step-by-step troubleshooting instructions to verify your settings, reset your connection, and get your tasks and events syncing smoothly.

Quick tip

Before you begin troubleshooting, make sure you’ve properly set up the Google Calendar integration.

How the Google Calendar sync works

A lot of sync “issues” turn out to be the integration working exactly as designed – just not quite the way you’d expect. Here’s a quick overview before you dive into troubleshooting:

  • Tasks only sync to Google Calendar if they have a date and time. A date alone isn’t enough, unless you’ve enabled Sync all-day tasks in Settings > Calendars.
  • Google Calendar events are read-only in Todoist. They appear in your Today and Upcoming views, but they won’t become tasks.
  • Google Tasks don’t sync – only Google Calendar events do.
  • Adding events directly to the Todoist calendar in Google Calendar won’t create new tasks in Todoist. The integration only syncs changes to events that are already linked to existing tasks.
  • Tasks are synced to a separate Todoist calendar. It’s not possible to select a different calendar to sync your tasks (for example, your primary calendar). If any of those points explain what you’re seeing, you may not need to troubleshoot anything at all. If something still seems off, read on.

Check for app updates

Before anything else, make sure you’re running the latest version of Todoist. Older versions can lose sync functionality after infrastructure updates.

If you’re on an older device, make sure it’s supported by Todoist.

Tasks aren’t appearing on Google Calendar

When you use the Calendar integration, tasks sync to a separate Todoist calendar in Google Calendar. If your tasks aren’t showing up, follow these steps to make the calendar visible and verify your sync settings.

Make the Todoist calendar visible
  • Open Google Calendar.
  • Look for the Todoist calendar in the left sidebar under My calendars.
  • Select the Todoist calendar to make it visible.
Verify task sync criteria

All tasks that match the following criteria will sync as events:

  • The task is in a non-shared project, or it’s been assigned to you in a shared project. Team projects are considered non-shared if there are no other members. Unassigned tasks in these projects will sync as Google Calendar events.
  • Tasks with a date and time (or date, time, and duration).
  • Tasks with a date (if you have the Sync all-day tasks option turned on in Settings > Calendars).
  • Tasks that aren’t deleted. Note

There’s no option to filter which tasks to sync.

Reset the integration

If an eligible task still isn’t syncing, disconnect and reconnect the integration. This resolves the majority of sync failures:

  • Click your avatar.
  • Select Settings.
  • Open the Calendars tab.
  • Click Disconnect.
  • Click Connect Google Calendar and follow the setup process again.

Completed recurring tasks not showing as completed on Google Calendar

This is by design. If you complete an occurrence of a recurring task, the event stays on the calendar and doesn’t get a checkmark. The event will only get a checkmark if you complete the task forever.

Google Calendar events in Todoist

Google Calendar events appear in your Today and Upcoming views in Todoist, but they’re read-only – you can’t edit or complete them from within Todoist.

Google Tasks aren’t syncing

Only Google Calendar events sync with Todoist – Google Tasks don’t. If you want your Google content to appear in Todoist, make sure it’s saved as a calendar event rather than a task.

Creating new tasks from Google Calendar

Adding a new event to the Todoist calendar in Google Calendar won’t create a new task in Todoist. If you want to quickly add a task while you’re looking at Google Calendar, use the global Quick Add keyboard shortcut.

Sync delay for Google Calendar events

If Google Calendar events are taking a long time to appear in Todoist, try clearing the app’s local data:

  • Click your avatar.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select General.
  • Select Reload under Clear local data. If events are still missing after that, disconnect and reconnect the integration.

You’re no longer using the integration, and old Todoist calendars are appearing on Apple Calendar

Unfortunately, this is an issue on Google’s end.

If you’re seeing old Todoist calendars in the macOS/iOS calendar app you can follow these steps to remove them:

  • Log in to your Google Calendar account.
  • Click the gear icon to open settings.
  • Select the old Todoist calendar from the calendar list.
  • Click Delete at the bottom of the page on the right to delete it.
  • Restart the Calendar app.
Adding multiple Google Calendar accounts

You can only sync Todoist to one Google Calendar account. As a workaround, you can subscribe to other calendars – even from other calendar apps or different Google accounts – so their events appear in your main calendar and sync through to Todoist.

Google Calendar integration keeps disconnecting

Company IT restrictions

If you’re working within a company that has strict security policies, your IT software may be blocking the Todoist integration. This can cause it to repeatedly disconnect.

Reach out to your IT team and ask them to whitelist Todoist as a trusted tool.

OAuth authorization loop

If you’re getting stuck in a redirect loop when trying to connect Google Calendar – particularly in Chrome on Linux – try opening the authorization flow in a private or incognito browser window. This usually breaks the loop and lets the connection complete.

Get in touch

If you’re still experiencing issues with the Google Calendar integration, get in touch with us.

Troubleshoot issues with the Todoist for Gmail Add-on

The Todoist for Gmail add-on comes in handy when you need to add important emails as tasks. To use the add-on, log in to Gmail with your Google workspace account and click the Todoist icon in the right-hand sidebar.

However, if you see an error or the add-on stops working, this guide helps you troubleshoot these issues, so you can quickly get back on track.

Limitations

  • The Gmail add-on adds 00:00 as due time by default. If you leave the add-on at midnight, it considers the task as not having any due time. This is a limitation to the Google time picker.
  • If you set a due time without adding a due date to the task, Todoist won’t add due time to the task.
  • If you’re on the free plan, the task duration picker is hidden in the Gmail add-on.
  • If you set task duration to a task without adding a due date and due time, the add-on will ignore the task duration. Tasks created with the Todoist for Gmail add-on can’t open directly in Gmail for iOS. Tapping the email associated with the task will open a new browser tab on Safari for iOS.

Task links open a different Gmail account

When you add a task using the Todoist for Gmail add-on, the task saves with the URL of the email you’re adding. If you’re logged in to multiple Gmail accounts, Google will add a number to the URLs to identify which account an email is associated with.

The number reflects the order in which you logged in to those accounts. The first account you sign in to will have a “0”, the second account will have a “1”, and so on.

For example, if you logged in to your personal, work, and freelance Gmail accounts, their respective links would look like the following:

  • personal - mail.google.com

  • work - mail.google.com

  • freelance - mail.google.com If you’ll log out and re-log in to all of those Gmail accounts in a different order, the numbers will be associated with a different account:

  • work - mail.google.com

  • freelance - mail.google.com

  • personal - mail.google.com Before the change of login order, the link https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#starred/158bf0e7285ae8ad would have pointed to an email under the personal account.

After the change of login order, it will now point to the work account. Since the link opens up a different Gmail account, the email will no longer be accessible.

To resolve this, you’ll need to log back in to your Gmail accounts in the same order you used when you originally added those emails as tasks.

Spinning circle while using the add-on in Safari

If you’re using Safari, and a spinning circle appears while using the Todoist for Gmail add-on, follow these steps to allow pop-up windows for the browser:

  • Open Safari on your desktop computer.
  • Log in to your Todoist account at todoist.com.
  • Click Safari in the main menu at the top-left.
  • Select Preferences…
  • Open the Websites tab.
  • Scroll down and select Pop-up Windows to the left.
  • Open the menu next to todoist.com and select Allow.

Add-on error while using Gmail for iOS

If you’re using the Todoist for Gmail add-on while on an iOS device, you may see an error message indicating that something went wrong while executing the add-on.

This happens because the Gmail app for iOS isn’t giving Todoist the permission it needs to grab the email subject line.

Unfortunately, this means the add-on no longer works with Todoist on your iOS device. A workaround would be to use the add-on through the web browser on your computer.

Get help

If you’re experiencing any other issues with the Todoist for Gmail add-on that’s not covered in this guide, get in touch with us.

Troubleshoot Outlook Calendar integration issues in Todoist

Is your Outlook Calendar not syncing correctly with Todoist? Are events missing or changes not reflecting as expected? If you’re running into issues with the Outlook Calendar integration, follow these troubleshooting steps to get everything working smoothly again.

Recurring date limitations

Tasks with recurring dates will sync as recurring events in Outlook Calendar. There are, however, a few exceptions:

  • When a recurrence isn’t supported by Outlook Calendar, Todoist creates a regular event for the current occurrence, then creates a new one when the next occurrence comes up.

  • Rescheduling the current task occurrence to a different day or time won’t sync the change to the recurring event in Outlook Calendar. Updating the recurrence in Outlook Calendar will generally sync back to Todoist; however, there are two scenarios that don’t sync:

  • Updating a single instance of an event (“this event only”)

  • Complex custom recurrences (“every day except Friday”)

Unsupported recurrences
  • Every 1st month, 10th
  • Every 10th day, 15th day
  • Every 1st mon, 2nd tues
  • Every X months
  • Multiple days and months (for example: every March 1, 10 April)
  • Hourly recurrence (for example: every 2 hours)
  • Any recurrence based on completion date (every!)
  • Multiple days of a month (for example: every 2nd, 14th, 28th of each month)
  • Multiple weekdays in the same month (for example: every 2nd and 4th Friday)

Calendar permissions

Todoist is a trusted Microsoft partner, and the Outlook Calendar integration follows Microsoft’s recommended OAuth security flow. The integration requests only the necessary permissions:

  • Calendars.ReadWrite – Allows Todoist to read and write events in your calendars. This enables you to view calendar events in Todoist and sync scheduled tasks as Outlook events.
  • email – Grants access to your email address to confirm which account is connected to Todoist. These permissions apply to both personal Outlook accounts (live.com) and Microsoft 365 accounts (office365.com). For more details, see Microsoft’s permissions overview or the Todoist Security and Privacy FAQ.

Note

Todoist only controls the permissions it requests from Microsoft. How Outlook interprets and displays synced tasks, including privacy settings, lock status, or how events appear in shared calendars, is determined by your Outlook account and organization settings and is outside of Todoist’s control.

If you’ve granted the appropriate calendar permissions, but you’re still having issues with the integration, these troubleshooting steps may help resolve them:

Refresh your calendar manually

When you add a new calendar or change an existing calendar’s color, Outlook doesn’t notify Todoist of these changes. To refresh your calendar list to show these updates:

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click the Calendars tab.
  • Click the Resync button. Todoist will update your calendar list.

Check Microsoft 365 admin consent

For Microsoft 365 Education or Business accounts (office365.com), admin approval might be required to access the Outlook Calendar integration. This happens when Microsoft organizations restrict third-party app consent.

If you see a message indicating that admin approval is needed when trying to connect, request access from your Microsoft 365 admin with the following details:

  • Application Name: Todoist for Outlook Calendar
  • Application (Client) ID: abdc6ca6-1e22-47a1-aaf9-3265b713b1a8 Your admin can grant organization-wide consent to Todoist by following the steps in Microsoft’s Entra ID documentation.

If your organization has an admin consent workflow, submit a request when connecting Outlook to Todoist. Your admin can then review and approve your request.

After approval, reconnect your Outlook Calendar in Todoist and Resync to ensure everything works properly.

Log in to the correct Outlook account

If you have two or more Outlook accounts, and you initially logged in with one of these, Todoist may consistently and automatically log in to that account without giving you the option to choose another account. To fix this:

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click the Calendars tab.
  • Disconnect the Outlook integration.
  • Revoke calendar access to the Microsoft account:
    • Microsoft personal account: Open this link and click Don’t allow for the Todoist Outlook Calendar app.
    • Microsoft 365 business account: Open this link and click the three dots icon on the Todoist Outlook Calendar app. Then, click Remove.
  • Log in to the correct Microsoft account.
  • Reconnect the calendar integration.

Common issues

Here are some of the common issues with the Outlook Calendar integration, and steps to resolve them:

If your Todoist tasks aren’t visible after you’ve successfully connected your Outlook account, check if you’ve clicked “Show all” in the Outlook calendars list. Select the Todoist calendar from the list to make it visible in Outlook

An “Out of sync” message in your Outlook Calendar settings means Todoist can’t retrieve your calendar data because of specific errors.

  • 403 forbidden error: Todoist doesn’t have permissions to access your calendar’s data because third-party apps have limited access to your account. Admins may also be limiting third-party app access to only a group of mailboxes via an application access policy.

  • Contact your admin to ensure that the Todoist app has Calendars.ReadWrite and email permissions granted.

  • 404 not found error: Todoist can’t access the calendar’s data. You may, for example, see this error: The mailbox is either inactive, soft-deleted, or is hosted on-premise. It means you could be missing a valid Microsoft Office 365 license.

  • Contact your admin to check that you have a valid license for your account. If you see a “Couldn’t connect your account” pop-up message after trying to connect Outlook Calendar to Todoist, check the following:

  • Click Accept on the Microsoft permissions screen that comes after clicking “Connect Outlook Calendar”.

  • Check if you’ve enabled specific browser security settings. For example, Microsoft Edge has a “Strict” security setting that will block connections to any third-party app. When integrating both your personal and shared Outlook calendars into Todoist, you might notice duplicate events from these calendars. This is because events from shared calendars are synced alongside your personal events, leading to duplicates when both calendars contain the same event.

If you prefer to hide events from your shared calendars in Todoist:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Click the Calendars tab.
  • Click the visibility icon beside the Outlook Calendar to hide its events. When calendar events in Todoist or Outlook Calendar appear at incorrect times, review your account time zone in both apps. In Todoist, make sure to choose a geographical timezone (for example: Europe/Paris), rather than a GMT+HH timezone. Check if your device is set to the same time zone.

If you change the time zone in Outlook Calendar, and calendar events appear at incorrect times in Todoist or vice versa, follow these steps:

  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Settings.
  • Select the Calendars tab.
  • Toggle the Sync tasks to calendar option off.
  • Wait for 10-20 seconds.
  • Toggle the same option on again.

Troubleshoot syncing issues in Todoist

Did you create a task in the Todoist web app, and it’s not showing up on any of your other devices? To prevent losing any of your data, follow these troubleshooting steps to get Todoist syncing again.

Before you try other fixes

Don’t clear your browser cache, cookies, or local data yet. If Todoist hasn’t finished syncing, clearing this data can remove tasks or changes that haven’t saved to the servers. Work through the steps below first.

If you still need to clear your cache or cookies afterward, follow the warning prompt steps in Check for error or warning messages below to preserve any unsynced data.

Check if extensions or plugins are blocking Todoist

If you’re using the Todoist web app, a good place to start is to check if there’s a browser extension or plugin that’s interfering with Todoist.

Open a private or incognito browser window, and log in to app.todoist.com. This is so it’s clean of any plugins or extensions. If Todoist works, an extension or plugin may be blocking your connection to the Todoist servers.

Check your internet connection

If you use a VPN, firewall, or any other security-related measure at home or work, they may be blocking access to the Todoist servers. Try turning these off temporarily or adding todoist.com to your allowlist, and see if you’re able to sync Todoist again.

If you’re using Todoist for iOS or Android, check the Apple or Google support guides to see if cellular data is enabled for Todoist.

Perform a manual sync

Sometimes a fresh sync can resolve inconsistencies in Todoist. Here’s how to sync your tasks and projects manually in the Todoist apps:

Select Platform:

  • Log in to Todoist at todoist.com.
  • Click your avatar at the top-left.
  • Select Sync.
  • Tap Browse at the bottom-right.
  • Tap the gear icon in the top-right.
  • Tap Sync.
  • Tap Browse in the bottom-right.
  • Tap the gear icon in the top-right.
  • Tap About.
  • Tap Sync last completed. If Todoist still fails to sync on your devices, continue to the next step.

Check if the correct account is logged in

When Todoist on one device isn’t syncing with another device, there may be two different Todoist accounts logged in on each device. This may be because of multiple accounts or a new account was created by mistake.

Check if you’re logged into the same account on each platform in the account settings.

  • In the Todoist web app, Todoist for macOS, and Todoist for Windows, click your avatar. The email address associated with the account is displayed above Settings.
  • In Todoist for iOS and Todoist for Android, tap the gear icon to open Settings. Then, tap Account to see the email address associated with the Todoist account. Warning

Make sure to check both email addresses carefully. In some cases it can happen that a new account was created due to a small and barely noticeable typo (i.e. one of your accounts is linked to dave@todoist.com and the other one to dave@todoist.con).

Update Todoist to the latest version

Running an outdated version of Todoist can cause sync issues. Regularly update the Todoist app on all your devices to ensure you have the latest version.

If you’re having trouble updating to the latest version, check this guide to verify if your device is running on a supported operating system, or if you’re using the latest version of your web browser.

Check for error or warning messages

In most cases, Todoist shows a warning prompt when it’s not syncing correctly. This prompt shows a yellow triangle at the top.

Click this prompt to see a description of the issue. It’ll give you information about why the Todoist app isn’t syncing and how to resolve it (for example: you might’ve reached a project limit).

If your data hasn’t synced, and you’re about to log out of Todoist or clear local data, clicking the warning prompt will display more details. Make copies of data that aren’t syncing before doing so.

Check your plan limits

Each Todoist plan has specific limits to ensure smooth performance. Hitting any of these limits could cause sync issues.

Learn about the different plan limits, and check your Todoist account to see if it’s maxed out the plan limits.

Perform a sync test in Todoist

After completing all these steps, let’s do a sync test:

  • Log in to Todoist using a web browser.
  • Perform a manual sync, so you have the most up-to-date version of your tasks and projects.
  • Create a test task in any project or view.
  • Switch to Todoist on another device (for example: Todoist for iOS) and see if the test task appears on that device.
  • Create another test task in the same project or view while using this device.
  • Switch to the Todoist web app and see if the second test task appears in your project or view. At the end of the sync test, the Todoist app in which you added a test task, but that isn’t syncing to your other devices, is affected by a sync issue.

Get help

If you’ve tried all the troubleshooting steps in this article, get in touch with us and include the following details in your report:

  • Todoist app(s) used for the sync test
  • App version numbers
  • Links to the test tasks
  • Type of data that isn’t syncing (for example: task, comment, label)
  • Screenshots of any errors or warning messages
  • Any other troubleshooting steps you’ve tried to resolve the issue

Troubleshoot the Todoist and Outlook Mail integration

Are you having trouble turning your Outlook emails into Todoist tasks? This troubleshooting guide provides steps to fix common issues with the integration, so you can get straight back to work.

Limitations

If you’re using the Outlook desktop app, and the Todoist add-in isn’t visible in your settings, your account may not have Connected Experiences turned on yet. Follow these steps to turn this option on for your Outlook Mail account.

If you’re trying to set up the Outlook add-in, but the Manage Add-ins option isn’t visible, you’re either using a corporate account where your administration disabled the installation of web add-ins, or you are using an account type that isn’t supported by web add-ins, like an IMAP or POP3 account.

Due to security restrictions that Google places upon apps, it’s not possible to use Google login to authenticate your Todoist account. As a workaround, add a password to your Todoist account, and use login via email and password to authenticate.

When clicking an Outlook email in a Todoist task, your default web browser opens a new tab automatically where you can view the email. It’s not possible to view the email right in Outlook.

Errors

If you’re signing in to the Outlook add-in with your Google account, you may see this error message:

This browser or app may not be secure.

To resolve this, open Outlook web app and log in with your Google account.

If you’re using the Outlook desktop app or mobile app, log in with your Todoist email address and password instead. If you don’t have a password, here’s how to add one.

When using the Outlook Add-in, you may see this error message:

Outlook plugin is unverified and needs admin approval.

To resolve this, contact your network admin to grant access to the Integrated Apps option in the O365 admin portal. Then, have them select Add Apps and search for Todoist for Outlook.

From there, your network admin can choose to deploy the integration either for all users or for specific users. They’ll need to agree to the required permissions:

  • Read your mail
  • Sign you in and read your profile
  • Maintain access to data you have given it access to If you’re using Todoist on a company network, and you see an error that starts with:

Something went wrong

AADSTS: error description

Contact your IT department or administration and provide the exact AADSTS error code (for example: AADSTS50158) to help with troubleshooting. Here’s a full list of Microsoft AADSTS error codes.

If you’re consistently seeing a message about a missing weblink, there are two likely reasons:

  1. Your IT team may be blocking email links from being accessed by our integration through Microsoft. If that’s the case, we recommend reaching out to them to request an exception for Todoist.

  2. Microsoft may not be providing the link at all. We’re not sure why this happens—we’ve reached out to them but haven’t received a response. If this is the case for you, unfortunately, there’s nothing we can do on our end to fix it.

Missing or archived email messages

The Outlook add-in needs your permission to access the Microsoft Graph API to fetch a robust link to the email. This link is attached to your Todoist task. This is the only time Todoist requests your permission to access the API, nothing else.

If you’re using the Outlook add-in, and it keeps prompting you to log in to your Microsoft account when clicking the link, the email has likely been moved, archived or deleted.

To get access to an email that has been moved, archived or deleted, the integration will prompt you to log in to your Microsoft account and grant permission to use the Microsoft Graph API. After granting permission, the email link will then work, even if the email has been moved, archived or deleted.

If you choose to log out of your account in the add-in settings, you’ll also log out of both your Todoist account and your Microsoft account.

If you’ve used the Outlook add-in to create a task, and then moved the linked email out of the folder it was saved to, the link becomes invalid and you won’t be able to use it anymore.

To resolve this, use the add-in to create a new task from the email’s new location. We recommend deleting the old task with the broken link in Todoist.

Get in touch

If you’ve tried all the troubleshooting steps in this article, or if you’re seeing a new issue when using the integration, get in touch with us and include the following details in your report:

  • Outlook and Todoist app version numbers
  • Screenshots of any errors or warning messages
  • Any other troubleshooting steps you’ve tried to resolve the issue

Add a task description in Todoist

When collaborating with others, a task may need a bit more context than what you can fit into a task name. That’s where task descriptions come in handy! It’s where you can add provide additional information about the work, or share links that are relevant to the task. If you need to duplicate the task, all the details stay right where they are.

You can save a task while in the task description field, by using the shortcut Ctrl + Enter (for Windows) or ⌘ Command + ↵ Return (for macOS).

  • Tap the red Dynamic Add button.
  • Give the task a name.
  • Tap the + icon below the task name to reveal the description field. You can enter up to 16,384 characters of text.
  • Enter the task description.
  • Tap the submit icon. Note

You can view task descriptions on Todoist for watchOS, but they’re hidden when using the Todoist widget.

  • Tap the red Dynamic Add button.
  • Give the task a name.

  • Enter the task description.
  • Tap the submit icon. Note

You can view task descriptions while using Todoist on a Wear OS device.

Add a task description to an existing task

Select Platform:

  • Click the task to add a task description to. This opens the task view.
  • Click the description field.
  • Enter the description for the task. You can enter up to 16,384 characters of text.
  • Click Save to confirm.
  • Tap the task to add a task description to. This opens the task view.
  • Tap the Description chip.
  • Enter a description for the task. You can enter up to 16,384 characters of text.
  • Tap the red check icon at the top-right to confirm
  • Tap the task to add a task description to. This opens the task view.
  • Tap the .
  • Enter a description for the task. You can enter up to 16,384 characters of text.
  • Tap Save at the top-right to confirm. Marco · Customer Experience Specialist

Deleted a task with a lot of information by accident? Task descriptions are included in backups, so your data stays safe. On the Pro and Business plans, backups run automatically and come with higher usage limits.

Search for a task based on the task description

To search for a task based on its task description, click or tap Search from the sidebar or navigation, and enter text that match the task description.

If you’re using the Todoist web or desktop apps, task descriptions are displayed as bold text in the search results.

If you’re using the Todoist mobile apps, you’ll see a row of tabs above your search results. Tap the Descriptions tab to view task descriptions that match your search criteria.

Add comments and files to tasks

Select Platform:

  • Tag someone to notify them about your comment, if needed.

  • Click Comment to save it. Comments are always listed chronologically in the task. You can’t manually change their order.

Project comments are attached to the whole project rather than a single task. They keep any high-level project information or files organized and in one place. If you’re working in shared projects, project comments are handy for keeping everyone on the same page.

Select Platform:

Notify someone about a comment

There will be times when you write a comment and want to make sure your teammate sees it. In those cases, you can notify them.

To notify someone about a task comment in a personal project, you’ll need to first share the project. To notify someone in a team project, make sure that person is part of your team. Then, follow these steps:

Select Platform:

Note

If you’re posting the first task comment without notifying a specific person, the task creator, assignee, and assignor will receive a notification about the comment. If there’s at least one comment in the task, the people who’re initially notified will receive any other comment added to the task.

If you need to tag the person right in the comment:

  • Click either the task comment field or the project comment field.

  • Enter @ in the comment field and start typing out their name. You’ll see a list of names that match. Click the name of the person to tag in the comment.

  • Write your comment or attach a file.

  • Click Comment. If you’d like to notify the person without tagging them directly in the comment:

  • Write your comment or attach a file.

  • Click Comment. Note

If you’re posting the first task comment without notifying a specific person, the task creator, assignee, and assignor will receive a notification about the comment. If there’s at least one comment in the task, the people who’re initially notified will receive any other comment added to the task.

If you need to tag the person right in the comment:

If you’re posting the first task comment without notifying a specific person, the task creator, assignee, and assignor will receive a notification about the comment. If there’s at least one comment in the task, the people who’re initially notified will receive any other comment added to the task.

If you need to tag the person right in the comment:

  • Enter @ in the comment field and start typing out their name. You’ll see a list of names that match. Tap the name of the person to tag in the comment.

  • Write your comment or attach a file.

FAQ

No, Todoist supports only Unicode emoji. The two main reasons for not supporting anything other than Unicode are:

To avoid formatting issues, press Cmd + Shift + V (macOS) or Ctrl + Shift + V (Windows) when pasting multiple lines of text in Todoist.

Select Platform:
